options: A. 說話者無法理解反應，因此反對所有申訴。
B. 裁判已因他的反應而正式改判。
C. 能理解他的反應，不代表能接受他對裁判的說話方式。
D. 說話者因理解原因而接受了他對裁判的態度。
normal.explain: 理解動機與認可行為可區分。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The format rewards taking risks, but only within a framework that limits how much one failed attempt can cost.
options: A. 賽制鼓勵冒險，並讓單次失敗決定全部結果。
B. 賽制只獎勵不冒風險而穩定完成的人。
C. 賽制已取消失敗紀錄以免影響結果。
D. 賽制鼓勵冒險，但框架限制單次失敗的代價。
normal.explain: 風險回報與損失限制並存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would distinguish making the competition accessible from making every match equally easy to win.
options: A. 說話者認為應以難以報名來維持比賽品質。
B. 比賽的參與條件已被改成只接受優勝者。
C. 我會區分讓比賽容易參與與讓每場都同樣容易贏。
D. 比賽容易參與就應確保每個人同樣容易獲勝。
normal.explain: 可及性與勝負難度是不同目標。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The impressive result may owe something to the system, but the system was introduced just as several unusually strong players joined.
options: A. 強手加入已證明制度對成績沒有任何作用。
B. 制度早已推出多年，強手加入與結果毫無關聯。
C. 好成績已被確定完全是新制度造成。
D. 好成績可能部分來自制度，但制度推出時恰有幾位強手加入。
normal.explain: 同時發生的人員變動是替代影響，不排除制度部分功勞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like a failure of commitment may be a failure to offer a schedule that people with other commitments can actually manage.
options: A. 看似投入不足，可能是時程未顧及人們其他責任。
B. 參加者已承認缺席只是因為不喜歡活動。
C. 時程安排合理與否可由出席低直接證明。
D. 人們只要足夠投入就能取消任何其他責任。
normal.explain: commitment 的投入/既有責任雙義形成重評，不確定指責個人。

normal.desc: 【語意】The team’s dominance was short-lived. Which account matches this?
options: A. They led briefly before other teams caught up.
B. They remained unbeaten throughout several seasons.
C. They entered few events but won every one.
D. They improved gradually without ever taking the lead.
normal.explain: short-lived 指維持不久；dominance 是優勢地位。

normal.desc: 【文法】So evenly ___ that no side led by more than a point.
options: A. the teams were matching
B. matched were the teams
C. the teams matched were
D. were matched the teams
normal.explain: So evenly matched were the teams that ... 程度詞前置倒裝；matched 作分詞形容狀態。

normal.desc: 【語域】Which comment concedes defeat without diminishing the winners’ achievement?
options: A. They won, although anyone could have done so in those conditions.
B. Their victory owes more to our mistakes than to their play.
C. We had opportunities, but they made better use of theirs.
D. The result says more about our bad luck than their ability.
normal.explain: 正答承認雙方機會與對手較佳把握；其餘將勝利貶為幸運或對方失誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】He insisted on ___ as a beginner, despite his previous experience.
options: A. having treat
B. being treated
C. treating him
D. be treated
normal.explain: insist on 後用動名詞；主詞 he 接受對待，用 being treated。

normal.desc: 【短文】A club removes rankings to reduce pressure but still allocates its best time slots according to recent results. What tension remains?
options: A. The best time slots are now distributed without considering results.
B. Removing rankings has necessarily made players more competitive.
C. Competitive outcomes still determine access to a desirable benefit.
D. The club has eliminated every practical consequence of performance.
normal.explain: 明面排名取消，資源分配仍依成績；不推論心理必然更競爭。

normal.desc: 【語意】Her composure should not be mistaken for indifference. What is being distinguished?
options: A. Remaining calm from being able to understand the rules.
B. Caring about the outcome from following the rules.
C. Showing disappointment from having practised regularly.
D. Remaining calm from caring little about the outcome.
normal.explain: composure 是鎮定，不等於不在乎。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am not convinced the new format rewards consistency quite as much as its designers suggest. What is the speaker questioning?
options: A. The designers’ willingness to describe the format publicly.
B. Whether any player has ever performed consistently.
C. The extent to which the format favours steady performance.
D. Whether the format contains any scoring rules at all.
normal.explain: not ... quite as much 降低程度，非否定一致表現存在。

normal.desc: 【短文】A coach praises a risky move when it succeeds and condemns the same decision when it fails, without considering the information available beforehand. What distinction would improve the assessment?
options: A. A player’s willingness to listen versus the coach’s experience.
B. The complexity of a move versus the time available after the match.
C. The crowd’s reaction versus the official record of the score.
D. The quality of a decision versus the outcome of a single attempt.
normal.explain: 評估決策應看當時資訊，不只以單次成敗倒推。

normal.desc: 【立場】The captain accepts that a rule was technically followed while disputing that the action was sporting. What does she preserve?
options: A. A distinction between formal compliance and fair conduct.
B. A claim that the official score must therefore be incorrect.
C. A requirement that every sporting action produce a close result.
D. A distinction between individual and team competitions.
normal.explain: 規則符合與運動精神判斷不同，不自動推翻比數。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：壓力下保持冷靜的鎮定
請唸出單字：利用規則邊緣手段取得心理或競賽優勢
請唸出：容許判斷空間的裁量決定
請唸出：需要投入不少時間精力的承諾
請唸出：鎮定不應與漠不關心混淆
normal.ans: COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH INDIFFERENCE
normal.speak: composure should not be confused with indifference
normal.vocabId: R7:COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH INDIFFERENCE

normal.desc: 請唸出：好決策仍可能得到不幸結果
normal.ans: A GOOD DECISION CAN STILL HAVE AN UNFORTUNATE OUTCOME
normal.speak: a good decision can still have an unfortunate outcome
normal.vocabId: R7:A GOOD DECISION CAN STILL HAVE AN UNFORTUNATE OUTCOME

normal.desc: 請拼出：對他人有禮大方而體諒的（G 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：有機會爭取勝利或職位的競逐者（C 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：展現公平競爭精神的（S 開頭，8 個字母）
填空題：S E E _ I N G (依實力排名安排賽事位置的做法)
填空題：F O _ F _ I T (因違規或未履行條件而喪失權利或比賽)
填空題：O _ T _ L _ Y (在比賽表現上勝過對手)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 正式撤回先前全部支持
B. 附有條件或保留的支持
C. 具備專業資格者的任何聲明
D. 沒有任何保留的全力支持
normal.explain: qualified 在此是受限定的，不是專業資格。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 經宣誓逐字承認
B. 尚未有人聽見的傳言
C. 未明說卻隱含承認
D. 以正式文件明確否認
normal.explain: tacit 指未直接表達而由行為語境暗示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 內含過多數字的問題
B. 已下載到裝置的問題
C. 完全無法用口語表達的問題
D. 帶有未獲接受預設的問題
normal.explain: loaded question 帶有立場或預設，不能只看句長。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 內容已確定為真的爆料
B. 只為增加字數的標題
C. 措辭謹慎的免責或限制聲明
D. 未經閱讀便轉傳的引文
normal.explain: disclaimer 用以限制責任、適用範圍或關聯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The quotation is genuine; the impression created by placing it next to that photograph is another matter.
options: A. 照片是真的，所以旁邊引文也已獲證實。
B. 引文已被證明偽造，照片則尚待查核。
C. 只要引文正確，任何並列方式都不影響解讀。
D. 引文是真的，但與那張照片並列所產生的印象需另論。
normal.explain: 單項真實性與組合框架效果分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would take her silence as a reason to ask, not as permission to announce her agreement.
options: A. 我會因她沉默而去問，不會據此宣布她同意。
B. 我會先宣布同意，再請她說明反對理由。
C. 她沉默已足以確認不同意，無需再問。
D. 詢問只會改變她原本已明示的同意。
normal.explain: 沉默不足以替他人宣告同意，也未定為反對。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The summary preserves the conclusion while quietly discarding the qualifications that made it a cautious one.
options: A. 摘要刪掉結論，只保留過多限制條件。
B. 摘要原封保留結論與所有保留措辭。
C. 原文沒有結論，所以摘要自行另寫一個。
D. 摘要保留結論，卻刪去原本使其審慎的限定。
normal.explain: 刪去 qualifications 提高語氣確定性，不代表結論文字變動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The report may be accurate sentence by sentence while remaining misleading in the pattern of what it chooses not to mention.
options: A. 逐句正確仍可能因選擇性省略而誤導。
B. 逐句正確已足以排除誤導，剩下問題只是報告篇幅不夠長。
C. 因省略本來就屬必要編輯，所以報告的取捨不需要另行檢視。
D. 報告之所以誤導，是因省略部分使已寫出的每句話都成為假話。
normal.explain: 事實正確與資訊選擇完整公允不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The interviewer’s challenge sounds forceful, but it accepts the premise that the dispute is only about how the policy is presented.
options: A. 說話者認為追問框架足以挑戰政策，但語氣不夠堅定有力。
B. 追問語氣強硬，框架卻只容許爭議在呈現方式。
C. 追問不但挑戰政策呈現，也已明確否定政策本身的合理性。
D. 採訪者先接受政策內容，來賓後來才說爭議只在呈現方式。
normal.explain: 語氣強弱不等於問題框架觸及實質。

normal.desc: 【語意】The article attributes the estimate to an unnamed source. What does it establish?
options: A. The article withdraws the estimate because nobody has agreed to be named.
B. The article identifies the estimate as coming from someone whose name it withholds.
C. The article confirms the estimate using a source whose identity is publicly documented.
D. The article presents the estimate as the reporter’s own calculation from published data.
normal.explain: attribution 是標明來源，unnamed 是未公開姓名，不等於已獨立驗證。

normal.desc: 【文法】The editor requested that the qualification ___ in the headline.
options: A. is retain
B. had retaining
C. be retained
D. was retaining
normal.explain: request that 後用原形虛擬式；qualification 被保留。

normal.desc: 【語用】A host responds, That is one way of putting it, after a guest describes a disputed decision as obvious. What is the likely implication?
options: A. The host confirms that no other wording is possible.
B. The host requests a literal translation into another language.
C. The host withdraws the question because the answer was inaudible.
D. The host leaves room for a different characterisation.
normal.explain: That is one way ... 常委婉表示另一種看法，無需斷言完全反對。

normal.desc: 【文法】The reporter denied ___ the quotation out of context.
options: A. had taken
B. have taking
C. having taken
D. to have taken
normal.explain: deny 後接動名詞；having taken 指先前被指控的行為。

normal.desc: 【短文】A report says that a witness disputed one detail of an account. Its headline says the witness rejected the account. What has changed?
options: A. A disagreement about detail has become an endorsement.
B. A first-hand account has become an anonymous rumour.
C. A public statement has become a private exchange.
D. A limited disagreement has become a broader rejection.
normal.explain: disputed one detail 範圍較小，headline 擴大拒絕範圍。

normal.desc: 【語意】The correction is conspicuous, though the withdrawal of the underlying allegation is conspicuously absent. What is the criticism?
options: A. A visible factual correction leaves the central accusation standing.
B. The central accusation has been withdrawn without any visible correction.
C. The correction is hidden while the accusation is prominently withdrawn.
D. Both the correction and the accusation have disappeared from the article.
normal.explain: 平行 conspicuous/absent 突出有改細節卻未撤核心指控。

normal.desc: 【短文】An interviewee says a plan could work if staffing increases. A summary reports that she said the plan could work, omitting the staffing condition. What is lost?
options: A. A guarantee that more staff will be recruited.
B. A statement that the interviewee opposes the plan.
C. A prediction that current staff will leave.
D. A condition limiting the claim’s applicability.
normal.explain: 省略 if 條件使有條件可行變得較無條件。

normal.desc: 【短文】A presenter gives equal speaking time to two guests, then describes one guest’s claims as evidence and the other’s as allegations without explaining the difference. What should a listener examine?
options: A. Whether the framing privileges one position despite equal airtime.
B. Whether equal airtime requires both guests to make identical claims.
C. Whether the guests were invited in the same order as they spoke.
D. Whether longer airtime would make the factual claims easier to verify.
normal.explain: 篇幅形式平等與措辭帶來的可信度不對稱不同。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The source denied suggesting that the decision was final, not that a decision had been discussed. Which denial is supported?
options: A. The source confirms having recommended the decision.
B. The source rejects having implied finality.
C. The source rejects any knowledge of a discussion.
D. The source confirms that the decision is now final.
normal.explain: 否定範圍在 suggesting final，不是否定有討論。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：以含蓄暗示傳達負面指控的話
請唸出單字：限制責任或適用範圍的聲明
請唸出：未明說但彼此理解的默契
請唸出：明顯而值得注意的遺漏
請唸出：否認針對簽名而非授權
normal.ans: THE DENIAL ADDRESSES THE SIGNATURE RATHER THAN THE AUTHORISATION
normal.speak: the denial addresses the signature rather than the authorisation
normal.vocabId: R7:THE DENIAL ADDRESSES THE SIGNATURE RATHER THAN THE AUTHORISATION

normal.desc: 請唸出：相同播出時間不必表示相同框架
normal.ans: EQUAL AIRTIME NEED NOT MEAN EQUIVALENT FRAMING
normal.speak: equal airtime need not mean equivalent framing
normal.vocabId: R7:EQUAL AIRTIME NEED NOT MEAN EQUIVALENT FRAMING

normal.desc: 請拼出：以不同措辭重述同一意思（P 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：表達刊物立場的社論（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：把某行為或動機歸於某人（I 開頭，6 個字母）
填空題：D E N _ A L (聲稱某事不屬實或與己無關的否認)
填空題：C A _ E _ T (對某說法附加的警告或限制)
填空題：E _ C _ R _ T (由較長作品摘出的片段)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 禁止任何後續修改的安排
B. 已被放棄而未採用的想法
C. 正式解方到位前的權宜措施
D. 為永久消除問題所作的保證
normal.explain: stopgap 是暫時補位，不保證永久解決。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只出於同情而未動工的計畫
B. 把原特色全部換掉的重建
C. 不考慮使用情境的仿製品
D. 尊重原有特色的修復
normal.explain: sympathetic 在修復語境指與原有性質協調。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 分次零碎處理的方式
B. 一次整體規劃並完成的方式
C. 只靠口頭而未執行的討論
D. 把所有工作交由同一人的安排
normal.explain: piecemeal 是逐塊分次，常暗示缺乏整體性，但不必完全無規劃。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 大家已同意的共同目標
B. 不需討論的次要背景
C. 為了開始會議而訂的時間
D. 引起爭議的問題
normal.explain: contention 在此是爭論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not attached to the chair itself; I object to finding that somebody has decided on my behalf that I no longer need it.
options: A. 我不執著椅子本身，而是反對別人代我決定我不再需要它。
B. 我只在意保留椅子，不在意是誰決定搬走。
C. 我已請別人替我決定，卻不滿他們沒有執行。
D. 椅子屬於大家，所以我認為只能由我處理。
normal.explain: 爭點從物件偏好轉到替他人決策的權限。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The proposal is economical on paper, though it assumes everyone can contribute time as readily as money.
options: A. 說話者認為出時間不應被視為任何貢獻。
B. 提案帳面上省錢，但假設每人都能像出錢般輕易出時間。
C. 提案較花錢，卻能保證每個人節省同樣時間。
D. 提案已把不同人的可用時間逐一換成金額。
normal.explain: 節省金錢的可行性依賴未經檢驗的時間資源假設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would call the change reversible only if putting things back is a realistic option, not merely a theoretical possibility.
options: A. 只有實際能恢復而非理論上可能，我才稱改動可逆。
B. 只要理論上能恢復，是否有資源執行並不重要。
C. 說話者認為改動一經完成就永遠無法回復。
D. 恢復後必須看起來更好，才可稱為可逆。
normal.explain: reversible 的實用標準須看可執行性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The disagreement is less about tidiness than about who gets to define what counts as clutter in a shared space.
options: A. 說話者認為只要訂清潔時間就已解決定義問題。
B. 爭議較關乎誰有權定義共用空間的雜物，而非整潔本身。
C. 雙方對雜物定義完全一致，只爭執誰該出錢。
D. 其中一方明確要求共用空間不應有任何物品。
normal.explain: 定義與決策權是核心，不只物品是否整齊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The new arrangement distributes inconvenience more evenly, which may be why those previously spared it are the least enthusiastic.
options: A. 原本免受不便者因而成為最熱烈支持者。
B. 大家同樣不熱衷，證明新安排並沒有改變。
C. 新安排較平均分攤不便，可能因此讓原本免受者最不熱衷。
D. 新安排把不便集中給原本受最多影響的人。
normal.explain: may 推測阻力來源，先前無負擔者如今需分擔。

normal.desc: 【語意】The renovation is sympathetic to the original design. What is praised?
options: A. The new design copies a different building more closely.
B. The project has restored every feature without alteration.
C. The changes respect the character of the earlier design.
D. The builders feel sorry for the people who designed the building.
normal.explain: sympathetic to design 指與原風格相協調，不保證逐件原樣復原。

normal.desc: 【文法】The sooner we agree on priorities, ___ time we will waste debating individual purchases.
options: A. less than
B. the least of
C. so little
D. the less
normal.explain: the sooner ..., the less ... 對應程度變化，time 不可數。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am all for improving the room, but I had hoped to recognise it afterwards. What is implied?
options: A. The speaker thinks the proposed changes go too far.
B. The speaker opposes any improvement to the room.
C. The speaker needs a label to identify the room’s address.
D. The speaker wants the completed room to be unrecognisable.
normal.explain: 先表支持，幽默地指出改造超出接受範圍。

normal.desc: 【文法】No amount of new storage ___ the disagreement about whose things may be moved.
options: A. resolve
B. are resolving
C. have resolved
D. resolves
normal.explain: 主詞 No amount ... 為單數；真正問題是移動權限。

normal.desc: 【短文】One resident says the common room is underused; another says it offers a quiet retreat precisely because it is not always occupied. What is disputed?
options: A. Whether low occupancy amounts to a lack of value.
B. Whether residents can physically enter the room.
C. Whether the room was designed for sleeping.
D. Whether every resident has the same key.
normal.explain: 使用價值不必只以占用率衡量，兩方對 underused 的判準不同。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The room is available subject to prior agreement on its use. What does this imply?
options: A. Only people who attended the previous meeting may enter.
B. Access depends on an arrangement made beforehand.
C. Any resident may use it first and seek approval later.
D. The room’s use has been permanently settled already.
normal.explain: subject to 引條件，prior 指先取得，不指定哪些人。

normal.desc: 【短文】A housemate treats the absence of objections as permission to replace shared furniture. Others say they had not been told a decision was imminent. What assumption is challenged?
options: A. That silence following insufficient notice amounts to informed agreement.
B. That replacing shared furniture can ever improve the room.
C. That the old furniture belongs to someone outside the household.
D. That a decision can be made before new furniture is delivered.
normal.explain: 沒有充分告知時的沉默不必是知情同意。

normal.desc: 【短文】A designer calls a room flexible because its furniture can be moved. Residents say moving it requires strength and time they do not have. What distinction matters?
options: A. The cost of new furniture versus the space occupied by old furniture.
B. The possibility of reconfiguration versus its practical availability to users.
C. The designer’s choice of colour versus the residents’ preferred decoration.
D. The room’s original purpose versus the date when the furniture was bought.
normal.explain: 形式上可變與使用者能否做到不同，題目未談顏色預算。

normal.desc: 【立場】The report praises consistency of style but questions whether consistency has become an excuse to disregard individual needs. What is the concern?
options: A. Consistency has been rejected as an aesthetic goal in every setting.
B. The building’s users have been given control over all design decisions.
C. Aesthetic coherence may be taking priority over usable variety.
D. Individual needs have been shown to require identical designs.
normal.explain: 承認美學優點但質疑優先序，不一概否定一致風格。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：適合人居住的
請唸出單字：提升使用舒適便利的設施
請唸出：可恢復原狀的介入改動
請唸出：未明說的所有權主張
請唸出：實用彈性取決於使用者實際能改什麼
normal.ans: PRACTICAL FLEXIBILITY DEPENDS ON WHAT USERS CAN ACTUALLY CHANGE
normal.speak: practical flexibility depends on what users can actually change
normal.vocabId: R7:PRACTICAL FLEXIBILITY DEPENDS ON WHAT USERS CAN ACTUALLY CHANGE

normal.desc: 請唸出：同等任務數可能掩蓋不等負擔
normal.ans: AN EQUAL TASK COUNT MAY CONCEAL UNEQUAL DEMANDS
normal.speak: an equal task count may conceal unequal demands
normal.vocabId: R7:AN EQUAL TASK COUNT MAY CONCEAL UNEQUAL DEMANDS

normal.desc: 請拼出：以現有物品臨時拼湊的（M 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：整修翻新以改善狀況（R 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：逐漸侵入他人空間或權益（E 開頭，8 個字母）
填空題：U P H O L _ T E R Y (家具表面的布料填充與包覆物)
填空題：H A B I _ A B I _ I T Y (適合居住的程度或狀態)
填空題：R E _ R _ F _ T (為舊設備或建物加裝新功能)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 保證情況絕不變動的正式承諾
B. 事情結束後才作的成效摘要
C. 沒有具體用途的額外裝飾
D. 為可能變動預作的備援安排
normal.explain: contingency arrangement 用以應對特定可能情況。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 讓相關人士提供意見的程序
B. 由一人不經討論直接決定的程序
C. 只公布既定結果而不收回應的公告
D. 以抽籤代替所有討論的辦法
normal.explain: consultative 指諮詢，不保證每份意見都被採納。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必定違反規定而不能執行的工作
B. 費力而少獲感謝的工作
C. 完全不用付出時間的任務
D. 被所有人爭相要求的獎勵
normal.explain: thankless 指辛苦卻不受賞識，不等於違規。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 象徵性或金額很小的貢獻
B. 以實際支出全額計算的付款
C. 不具名而且無法記錄的捐贈
D. 必須由主辦者親自完成的工作
normal.explain: nominal 在此指很小或象徵，不是不具名 anonymous。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The consultation may be genuine, but it is difficult to see what remains open when the venue, date and format have all been fixed.
options: A. 諮詢真誠已保證所有既定安排都會被取消。
B. 諮詢可能真誠，但場地日期形式已定，難看出還能改什麼。
C. 場地日期形式尚未定，所以諮詢完全沒有方向。
D. 說話者已證實主辦者根本沒有詢問任何意見。
normal.explain: 不直接指控虛假，質疑可影響的實質範圍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am happy to coordinate the replies, provided that does not quietly turn into being responsible for every arrangement.
options: A. 我已接受所有安排工作，只要求別人代收回覆。
B. 我不願與任何人聯繫，也不接受協調角色。
C. 我願協調回覆，只要不悄悄變成負責全部安排。
D. 我願負責全部安排，但不想知道誰會回覆。
normal.explain: 同意特定任務並防止責任不明擴張。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We should distinguish declining a particular task from withdrawing support for the event.
options: A. 說話者建議先取消活動，再請大家選擇工作。
B. 應區分拒絕某項任務與撤回對活動的支持。
C. 拒絕某項任務已充分表示不支持活動本身。
D. 只要支持活動，就等於同意任何後來追加的工作。
normal.explain: 任務界線不等於對總目標的態度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like effortless hospitality from the audience may depend on a remarkable amount of effort that the programme never acknowledges.
options: A. 接待之所以自然，已證明志工不需要事先準備。
B. 說話者認為只有被公開列名的工作才有實際價值。
C. 觀眾眼中自然輕鬆的接待，可能仰賴節目未提及的大量幕後付出。
D. 節目已完整承認所有工作，所以觀眾看出接待很費力。
normal.explain: 外顯輕鬆與幕後勞動並存；未被承認不等於沒價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation is generous in what it offers participants, rather less so in what it assumes organisers can supply indefinitely.
options: A. 邀請限制參加者所得，反而對主辦者提供過多補助。
B. 主辦者已明示所有資源無限，因此邀請沒有負擔問題。
C. 說話者只質疑邀請文字是否用了過多讚美形容詞。
D. 邀請對參加者大方，對主辦者卻預設能無限供應，較欠體諒。
normal.explain: 兩方角度的 generosity 評價不同，指出隱藏假設。

normal.desc: 【語意】The programme is ambitious rather than merely busy. What is emphasised?
options: A. The number of unrelated items already completed.
B. The organisers’ unwillingness to remove any item.
C. The amount of free time left between sessions.
D. The scale of what it aims to achieve.
normal.explain: ambitious 重點是企圖與目標尺度，非只是項目多。

normal.desc: 【文法】The organiser proposed ___ the final session optional.
options: A. making
B. to making
C. make it
D. that making
normal.explain: propose doing 表提議做某事，making session optional。

normal.desc: 【語用】I would be reluctant to promise that without first asking the people who would have to deliver it. What is withheld?
options: A. An admission that the speaker has attended the meeting.
B. A commitment made on behalf of an unconsulted team.
C. A description of work the team has already completed.
D. A request for the team to explain its preferred approach.
normal.explain: 不願未諮詢執行者就代作承諾，不等於拒絕詢問。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the availability survey been circulated earlier, we ___ the clash.
options: A. might have avoided
B. will avoid
C. had avoiding
D. might avoid yesterday
normal.explain: 過去反事實條件倒裝，主句 might have avoided。

normal.desc: 【短文】A committee asks for suggestions but announces the final programme before replies are due. Members wonder what the consultation could have changed. What is questioned?
options: A. Whether the committee had enough chairs for its meeting.
B. Whether the process allowed input to influence the decision.
C. Whether every member was entitled to receive an invitation.
D. Whether suggestions should be submitted as complete programmes.
normal.explain: 時間順序使實質影響空間存疑，非直接斷定所有成員被拒。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The support is offered on the understanding that the event remains free to attend. What would require renewed agreement?
options: A. Adding a free break between sessions.
B. Moving the reply deadline a day earlier.
C. Introducing an admission charge.
D. Changing the colour of the programme.
normal.explain: on understanding that 是承諾條件，收費會改變關鍵前提。

normal.desc: 【語用】It would help if the invitation distinguished between being welcome to contribute and being expected to do so. What distinction is requested?
options: A. A contribution in writing versus one made aloud.
B. An opportunity versus an obligation.
C. An invitation versus a notice of cancellation.
D. An experienced participant versus a beginner.
normal.explain: welcome to 可參與，expected to 有期待或責任感。

normal.desc: 【短文】Every volunteer receives the same briefing. Some are then assigned tasks requiring information the briefing never covered. The organiser cites equal treatment as proof of adequate preparation. What is the flaw?
options: A. Adequate preparation requires identical tasks for every volunteer.
B. The briefing’s length is the only reliable measure of its value.
C. Identical provision does not establish suitability for different roles.
D. Different roles necessarily require entirely separate organisations.
normal.explain: 相同資訊不等於符合各角色需求，非要求全部分開。

normal.desc: 【立場】The review values spontaneity but objects to making participants absorb the costs of decisions described as spontaneous. What is criticised?
options: A. Allowing any unscheduled interaction between participants.
B. The suggestion that planning can ever coexist with spontaneity.
C. The participants’ preference for deciding their own arrival times.
D. Using spontaneity to excuse transferring avoidable burdens to others.
normal.explain: 批評以自發作藉口轉嫁負擔，不否定自由互動。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：協助不同群體聯繫協調的人
請唸出單字：被委派角色的職責範圍
請唸出：原先未預料到的要求
請唸出：人數有限的志工群
請唸出：相同簡報未必足以準備不同角色
normal.ans: IDENTICAL BRIEFINGS MAY NOT PREPARE PEOPLE FOR DIFFERENT ROLES
normal.speak: identical briefings may not prepare people for different roles
normal.vocabId: R7:IDENTICAL BRIEFINGS MAY NOT PREPARE PEOPLE FOR DIFFERENT ROLES

normal.desc: 請唸出：成功救場不證成原計畫健全
normal.ans: A SUCCESSFUL RESCUE DOES NOT VINDICATE THE ORIGINAL PLAN
normal.speak: a successful rescue does not vindicate the original plan
normal.vocabId: R7:A SUCCESSFUL RESCUE DOES NOT VINDICATE THE ORIGINAL PLAN

normal.desc: 請拼出：透過詢問相關人士意見的（C 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：對某目的而言不可缺少的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
請拼出：使某過程較容易或順利進行（F 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：B R _ E F (對任務目的與要求的指示)
填空題：H O N _ R A _ I U M (為服務或演說致謝而付的酬金)
填空題：A C K _ O W L _ D G E _ E N T (對協助或貢獻公開致謝的表達)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 能引起豐富聯想的片段
B. 已完整記錄所有細節的總結
C. 失去一切可辨資訊的碎屑
D. 被判定毫無情感效果的引文
normal.explain: evocative 指能喚起感受或記憶。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已被確定是蓄意造假的複本
B. 部分依推測完成的重建
C. 完全未作任何改動的原件
D. 由作者親自提供的逐字說明
normal.explain: conjectural 不等於完全無根據或偽造。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不准轉售的共同持有協議
B. 缺少中間一代資料的繼承紀錄
C. 沒有已知中斷的所有權沿革
D. 由同一個人製作的金屬鏈
normal.explain: chain of ownership 比喻前後相接的持有歷史。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The scratch is slight, but the owner can tell you exactly when and how it happened.
options: A. 刮痕已修好，所以沒有留下相關記憶。
B. 刮痕很小，但主人能確切說出何時如何造成。
C. 刮痕很深，主人卻完全不記得來源。
D. 主人知道物件來處，但不知刮痕何時出現。
normal.explain: 物理痕跡程度與故事清楚程度不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What interests me is not that the object survived untouched, but that successive owners kept finding reasons to alter and retain it.
options: A. 主人每次改動後都立即丟棄物件，因此有趣。
B. 說話者認為保存物件必須禁止所有後人使用。
C. 我感興趣的是歷代主人不斷改用並保存，而非未改原樣留存。
D. 我只重視物件未改原樣，改動使它失去價值。
normal.explain: survival 可透過持續使用改動，不只靜態原封保存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The family story may be substantially right even if the date attached to it has drifted over time.
options: A. 日期有偏移已證明家族故事從未發生。
B. 日期準確，所以故事每項細節都已獨立查證。
C. 家族故事的價值只取決於日期是否最早。
D. 家族故事大體可能正確，即使相關日期隨傳述有偏移。
normal.explain: 局部記憶不準不自動否定整體，may 保留可能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The display invites nostalgia, but the letters beside it make that nostalgia rather less comfortable.
options: A. 展覽完全避開過往，信件則只描述未來。
B. 旁邊信件因與展品無關而被要求移走。
C. 展覽引人懷舊，但旁邊信件讓懷舊不那麼舒適。
D. 信件消除所有懷舊，讓人只感到厭惡。
normal.explain: 情感被複雜化而非完全取消，less comfortable 指不安。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The object’s ordinariness is precisely why it matters: it records a kind of life that more ceremonial objects can leave out.
options: A. 物件因普通而缺乏價值，只能作典禮物件的替代品。
B. 普通與典禮物件已被確定記錄完全相同的生活。
C. 物件的重要性只在於它比典禮物件數量更少。
D. 物件正因普通而重要，記錄了典禮物件可能漏掉的生活。
normal.explain: ordinary 可提供不同生活史視角，非以華麗稀有判價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The curator is not asking us to distrust memory, but to notice how a memory can be sincere and still change its emphasis over a lifetime.
options: A. 策展人非要求不信任記憶，而是注意真誠記憶仍可能隨人生改變重點。
B. 策展人認為記憶只要真誠就不會有任何變化。
C. 記憶重點改變已證明敘述者故意騙人。
D. 策展人只願使用從未經本人敘述的紀錄。
normal.explain: 真誠與重點變化可共存，非全盤抹除記憶。

normal.desc: 【語意】The provenance is documented only from the object’s arrival at the museum. What remains uncertain?
options: A. Its history before it entered the museum.
B. Whether the museum has recorded receiving it.
C. Whether the object is currently in a museum collection.
D. The existence of documentation after its arrival.
normal.explain: only from 限定紀錄起點，更早沿革未明。

normal.desc: 【文法】The portrait is thought ___ before the family moved away.
options: A. that it painted
B. to have been painted
C. to have painting
D. having been paint
normal.explain: is thought to have been painted 表據信先前被繪成。

normal.desc: 【語用】The guide says the room is remarkably unchanged, then points to a modern security camera. Which interpretation is most reasonable?
options: A. The modern camera proves that all earlier features have been replaced.
B. The guide is retracting every claim about the room’s earlier appearance.
C. The room largely retains its character despite a functional addition.
D. The guide claims that the camera was part of the original furnishing.
normal.explain: unchanged 可作整體描述，語境明示例外，非絕對原封。

normal.desc: 【文法】The drawer contained several letters, none of ___ had been catalogued.
options: A. that
B. which
C. them
D. whose
normal.explain: 逗號後非限定關係子句，none of which，不能用 them 接兩個完整子句。

normal.desc: 【短文】An exhibition places a worn apron next to a ceremonial uniform. The labels describe both as evidence of working lives, rather than treating only one as historically significant. What is the curatorial move?
options: A. Replacing historical interpretation with a list of clothing sizes.
B. Treating the ceremonial uniform as an object with no history.
C. Broadening the kinds of labour made visible through objects.
D. Claiming that all forms of work required the same clothing.
normal.explain: 並列日常與典禮物件擴大可見勞動，不是抹平差異。

normal.desc: 【語意】The restoration is conjectural in places. What should visitors understand?
options: A. Every part has been copied exactly from surviving original material.
B. The whole object has been proved unrelated to its stated period.
C. The repairs were made without anyone examining the surviving object.
D. Some details depend on informed reconstruction rather than direct evidence.
normal.explain: conjectural 部分依推測重建；in places 不等於全件虛構。

normal.desc: 【語用】The label says attributed to rather than made by. What difference does the wording mark?
options: A. The artist has formally denied making the object.
B. The maker’s name has been removed to protect privacy.
C. The maker’s identity is proposed with qualification.
D. The object is a deliberate copy made by the named artist.
normal.explain: attributed to 表歸屬推定，made by 較直接確定。

normal.desc: 【短文】A memoir describes an old kitchen as the centre of family life. Letters written at the time refer frequently to arguments there. The curator keeps both accounts. What does this permit?
options: A. The letters can be used to prove that nobody ever felt affection for the kitchen.
B. The memoir can replace the letters because later memory is always more complete.
C. The curator can avoid interpretation by declaring the two sources identical.
D. A later affectionate memory can be read alongside a more conflicted contemporary record.
normal.explain: 保留時間視角與矛盾複雜性，不用一份完全消滅另一份。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay values an object’s capacity to evoke a past without treating the feeling of recognition as proof that the past has been accurately recovered. What distinction matters?
options: A. Emotional resonance versus historical verification.
B. An object’s age versus its current selling price.
C. A visitor’s education versus the curator’s qualifications.
D. A written label versus an audio description of the same words.
normal.explain: 共鳴與事實核實不同，可有共鳴仍需證據。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：盡量逼近原件外觀的複製品
請唸出單字：物件表面因年代使用形成的色澤層
請唸出：能喚起聯想的並置
請唸出：事後回看時的理想化
請唸出：真誠記憶可能隨時間改變重點
normal.ans: A SINCERE MEMORY MAY CHANGE ITS EMPHASIS OVER TIME
normal.speak: a sincere memory may change its emphasis over time
normal.vocabId: R7:A SINCERE MEMORY MAY CHANGE ITS EMPHASIS OVER TIME

normal.desc: 請唸出：情感共鳴不證成歷史準確性
normal.ans: EMOTIONAL RESONANCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH HISTORICAL ACCURACY
normal.speak: emotional resonance does not establish historical accuracy
normal.vocabId: R7:EMOTIONAL RESONANCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH HISTORICAL ACCURACY

normal.desc: 請拼出：能強烈引起感受或聯想的（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：依推測而非確切證明的（C 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：根據個別經驗或故事而非系統資料的（A 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：C A T A _ O G U E (有系統列舉收藏或項目的目錄)
填空題：B E _ U _ S T (透過遺囑留下的財物或贈與)
填空題：A U T _ E N _ I C _ T E (確認物件或文件真實性的行動)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因沒認出對方而拒絕接待
B. 熱情洋溢的歡迎
C. 勉強維持禮貌的招呼
D. 未表任何情緒的通知
normal.explain: effusive 是情感外露而熱烈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因設備故障被迫終止活動
B. 完全不影響談話意思的空白
C. 充滿未說出口意味的停頓
D. 專為育兒安排的休息時間
normal.explain: pregnant 比喻充滿意義或可能性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以盛大儀式進入會場
B. 因未獲許可而無法入場
C. 建築內唯一能辨識的出口
D. 不太引人注意地進場
normal.explain: inconspicuous 表不顯眼，不等於非法或被拒。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I said I recognised the house, not that I knew which of its three doors we were supposed to use.
options: A. 房子只有一個入口，所以認不認得都無關。
B. 我已用過每道門，只是不想再進入屋內。
C. 我認得房子，不等於知道該用三道門的哪道。
D. 我認得三道門，所以確定不知道是哪棟房子。
normal.explain: 整體熟悉與具體操作資訊可不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She was gracious enough not to mention that the story I was telling was the one she had told me the week before.
options: A. 她指出我把上週故事改錯，所以我停止說話。
B. 我們各自在同一天獨立想出完全相同的故事。
C. 說話者特意先說明故事由她提供並向她致謝。
D. 她大方地沒指出，我正在講的是她上週告訴我的故事。
normal.explain: 善意不揭穿來源倒置，未交代說話者是否故意冒名。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: His expression suggested that the explanation had answered a question, though perhaps not the question he had actually asked.
options: A. 表情暗示解釋確有回答某問題，但未必是他問的那個。
B. 表情確認他完全沒聽到解釋，所以打算重問。
C. 解釋已完全回答原問題，只是他想再追問細節。
D. 說話者認為任何解釋都不應含有問題。
normal.explain: 承認可能有內容但與真正提問偏離，perhaps 保留。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apology was prompt, which was fortunate, since it arrived a moment before I discovered what he was apologising for.
options: A. 我發現問題很久後，他才終於肯道歉。
B. 他不知道自己為何道歉，所以請我解釋。
C. 道歉來得太早，因此已阻止任何事情發生。
D. 他道歉很及時，剛好在我發現需道歉的事前一刻。
normal.explain: 順序是先道歉後知事件；fortunate 可幽默減少衝突。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He told the story as if he had been a reluctant participant, although every practical detail depended on arrangements he had made himself.
options: A. 他講得像勉強被捲入，但每個安排細節其實由他親自促成。
B. 他已承認自己主導，所以敘述與實際安排一致。
C. 安排都由別人完成，他只是記住每個實用細節。
D. 說話者認為只要參與安排就一定享受所有結果。
normal.explain: 自我定位被動與實際策劃主動有張力，不推論所有情緒。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The joke depends on our noticing what the narrator seems determined not to notice about himself.
options: A. 讀者必須知道故事外的作者生平才會理解幽默。
B. 笑點靠我們看出敘述者似乎不肯察覺的自身問題。
C. 笑點完全靠敘述者明白說出自己每項缺點。
D. 敘述者刻意向讀者解釋笑點，所以再無言外之意。
normal.explain: 敘述者盲點與讀者理解差形成反諷，不要求外部背景。

normal.desc: 【語意】The host’s welcome was effusive. Which description fits?
options: A. She offered a practical explanation without any greeting.
B. She expressed delight with conspicuous enthusiasm.
C. She acknowledged the guest with restrained courtesy.
D. She avoided recognising the guest despite noticing him.
normal.explain: effusive 指熱情外露甚至洋溢，不是內斂客氣。

normal.desc: 【文法】Hardly had I set down the cup ___ someone knocked it over.
options: A. that
B. as if
C. when
D. than
normal.explain: Hardly had ... when ... 表剛做某事就發生另一事。

normal.desc: 【語用】Do come whenever you like, said the host, before consulting a notebook to list the evenings she would prefer him not to. What creates the humour?
options: A. The host has forgotten how to read her own notebook.
B. The guest has arrived on an evening already ruled out.
C. The notebook contains no information about evenings.
D. The broad invitation is immediately narrowed in practice.
normal.explain: whenever 與接著列限制形成反差，未說來賓已犯規。

normal.desc: 【文法】The bag, together with its contents, ___ exactly where she had left it.
options: A. have been
B. are being
C. was
D. were
normal.explain: 主詞 bag 單數，together with 不使主詞變複數。

normal.desc: 【短文】The narrator insists that he felt no jealousy, then recounts the rival’s new coat, better seat and louder applause in meticulous detail. What invites doubt?
options: A. The narrator has admitted jealousy directly in the same sentence.
B. The rival’s coat proves that he arranged the applause himself.
C. Detailed description necessarily means the narrator witnessed every event.
D. The attention he gives the rival sits awkwardly with his denial.
normal.explain: 敘述注意力與自稱無嫉妒有張力，未直接證明蓄意欺騙。

normal.desc: 【語意】She accepted the explanation with a politeness that did not quite amount to belief. What is distinguished?
options: A. A courteous response from inward conviction.
B. A written acceptance from an oral explanation.
C. An accurate memory from a convincing performance.
D. A willingness to listen from permission to remain.
normal.explain: 外在禮貌不等於內在相信。

normal.desc: 【文法】Her smile was the only indication ___ she had recognised him.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. what
D. that
normal.explain: indication that ... 為同位/內容子句，交代跡象指向何事。

normal.desc: 【短文】The narrator calls the neighbour impossible, but the only examples are occasions when she refused requests that inconvenienced her. What should a reader consider?
options: A. The judgement may reflect the narrator’s frustration at not getting his way.
B. The neighbour must have misunderstood every request before refusing it.
C. The narrator’s examples prove the neighbour is hostile in every setting.
D. The neighbour’s refusals establish that the requests were never made.
normal.explain: 人格標籤可能源於自利視角，未斷定鄰居全部行為皆合理。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am sure you meant well, says a character while moving the rearranged objects back to their former places. What is conveyed?
options: A. The intervention is welcomed because it requires no further discussion.
B. Good intentions are acknowledged without accepting the intervention.
C. The new arrangement has been accepted as a permanent improvement.
D. The speaker doubts that the objects have been moved at all.
normal.explain: 言語善意肯定配行動撤回，區分意圖與接受結果。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：不輕易透露想法的沉默寡言
請唸出：面對情況仍鎮定自持的能力
請唸出：以低調方式表達的責備
請唸出：能透露問題的前後不一致
請唸出：有禮回應不必等於內心相信
normal.ans: A COURTEOUS RESPONSE NEED NOT AMOUNT TO INWARD CONVICTION
normal.speak: a courteous response need not amount to inward conviction
normal.vocabId: R7:A COURTEOUS RESPONSE NEED NOT AMOUNT TO INWARD CONVICTION

normal.desc: 請唸出：敘述者把自身主動寫成勉強參與
normal.ans: THE NARRATOR PRESENTS HIS OWN INITIATIVE AS RELUCTANT INVOLVEMENT
normal.speak: the narrator presents his own initiative as reluctant involvement
normal.vocabId: R7:THE NARRATOR PRESENTS HIS OWN INITIATIVE AS RELUCTANT INVOLVEMENT

normal.desc: 請拼出：情感熱烈而外露的（E 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：不顯眼而不易引人注意的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
請拼出：基於尊重而順從或讓步的態度（D 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：R E P A _ T E E (敏捷機智的來回對答)
填空題：P _ I _ E (自然鎮定且有自信的儀態)
填空題：O _ L _ Q _ E (不直接明說而以暗示表達的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 正好超過所有設定上限
B. 完全不需與標準值比較
C. 在明定容許偏差範圍內
D. 只要使用者願意接受就算合格
normal.explain: specified tolerance 為明定範圍，不是主觀忍耐。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 實物完全沒有任何尺寸
B. 不准把圖案放在秤上
C. 每項距離都精確等於實物
D. 圖示未依實際比例繪製
normal.explain: not to scale 可保留結構順序，但不保證距離比例。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 反覆檢查並逐步修正的調整
B. 只做一次而不再檢視的改動
C. 完全不需回饋的隨機選擇
D. 僅在作品完成前禁止進行的程序
normal.explain: iterative 是重複循環，通常逐步修正。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The example is symmetrical for clarity, although the method does not depend on both sides being identical.
options: A. 方法要求對稱，所以每側尺寸必須照圖複製。
B. 範例故意不對稱，以示範兩邊要完全相同。
C. 說話者認為任何對稱範例都不能用來教學。
D. 範例為清楚而對稱，但方法不要求兩側相同。
normal.explain: 示範呈現選擇與方法必要條件不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We need a repeatable result, which is rather different from a result that happens to look right once.
options: A. 我們需要可重現結果，不是碰巧一次看來正確。
B. 只要一次看來正確，就已證明方法可重現。
C. 每次結果都必須看來不同，才算有重複實驗。
D. 說話者要求完成後不再保留任何檢查紀錄。
normal.explain: repeatable 重現性不同於偶然一次成功。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The measurement is precise, but it may be precisely wrong if the starting point has been misidentified.
options: A. 說話者認為精密與正確在任何情況都不能並存。
B. 量得精密，但若起點認錯，可能是精密地量錯。
C. 只要量得精密，起點選哪裡都不影響正確性。
D. 起點已被確認錯誤，所以所有刻度都需換掉。
normal.explain: precision 與參照正確性不同，may/if 為假設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The final step checks the outcome rather than causing it, so skipping the check does not establish that the earlier work succeeded.
options: A. 最後一步是檢查非製造結果，省略它不證明前面成功。
B. 省略檢查會自動讓前面做好的成果失去物理作用。
C. 最後檢查已完成，所以前面每個過程必定相同。
D. 只要做了前面步驟，檢查就完全沒有資訊價值。
normal.explain: 檢驗與造成結果不同；未檢查無法當成成功證據。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A wider tolerance may reduce the need for adjustment, but only if the wider range still meets the purpose of the design.
options: A. 調整次數少已足以證明結果適合所有用途。
B. 放寬容差可少調整，前提是範圍仍符合設計目的。
C. 容差越寬就無條件越好，不必再看用途。
D. 容差一放寬便必然無法製作任何物件。
normal.explain: 放寬要求需以功能適配為界，不是所有精度都可犧牲。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The diagram is easier to read because it simplifies the mechanism; that is also why we should not infer every physical detail from it.
options: A. 圖只要簡化，就無法提供任何正確機制資訊。
B. 說話者只在抱怨圖太小而看不清印刷文字。
C. 圖因簡化機制而易讀，也因此不能由圖推定全部實體細節。
D. 簡化使圖更易讀，所以全部細節都比實物完整。
normal.explain: 同一簡化帶來可讀性優點與細節限制。

normal.desc: 【語意】The dimensions are nominal. The note says actual measurements may vary slightly. What should users infer?
options: A. The dimensions describe only the names of the people who supplied the material.
B. Every piece is guaranteed to have the precise dimensions printed on its label.
C. The stated sizes identify a standard rather than promise exact physical measurements.
D. The sizes have been deliberately withheld until users finish the assembly.
normal.explain: nominal 配明示實際略有差異，為標準稱呼或標示值。

normal.desc: 【文法】The result will depend on how accurately the measurements ___ taken.
options: A. is
B. have
C. being
D. are
normal.explain: measurements 複數，be taken 被動，用 are。

normal.desc: 【語用】The guide calls the process forgiving: a small error need not spoil the result. What is meant?
options: A. It accommodates minor inaccuracies.
B. It requires the maker to apologise after each step.
C. It removes the need to check any measurements.
D. It guarantees success with every possible material.
normal.explain: forgiving 指容錯能力，small 限定可容錯範圍。

normal.desc: 【文法】The pattern is designed so that either of the two edges ___ serve as the base.
options: A. are
B. have
C. were
D. can
normal.explain: either 單一選項後情態 can + 原形 serve，其他不構成正確謂語。

normal.desc: 【短文】The instructions say to centre the image within the usable area, excluding the binding margin. A learner centres it on the full sheet. What is the discrepancy?
options: A. The learner has used a different reference area.
B. The learner has mistaken an image for a written title.
C. The instructions require the image to touch every edge.
D. The binding margin has been measured in the wrong unit.
normal.explain: centring 參照範圍是扣裝訂邊的可用區，不是全紙。

normal.desc: 【語意】The specification sets a tolerance rather than a single exact value. What is allowed?
options: A. Variation only after the finished object has been delivered.
B. A defined range of acceptable variation.
C. Any value the maker finds visually appealing.
D. A single value with no permissible deviation.
normal.explain: tolerance 在尺寸語境為明定容許偏差，不是任意值。

normal.desc: 【短文】A diagram exaggerates the gap between layers so readers can see their order. The caption says it is not to scale. What should not be copied directly?
options: A. The apparent distances between layers.
B. The stated sequence of the layers.
C. The names assigned to the layers.
D. The fact that the object has more than one layer.
normal.explain: not to scale 不按比例，仍可準確展示順序。

normal.desc: 【短文】A procedure says to repeat the previous step until the edges align. A learner repeats it exactly three times because the example does. What has been mistaken?
options: A. An instruction about edges for one about colour selection.
B. An illustrative instance for the stopping condition.
C. A stopping condition for a prohibition on checking alignment.
D. A required count for a recommendation to improvise.
normal.explain: until 給完成條件，例子三次不是固定配額。

normal.desc: 【語意】The instructions are exhaustive about materials but underspecified about sequence. What is lacking?
options: A. A requirement to avoid using any additional materials.
B. A complete list of the finished object’s possible uses.
C. Enough detail about the order of operations.
D. Enough detail about which materials are needed.
normal.explain: underspecified about sequence 是先後說明不足，非材料列表不全。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：將量測調到符合參照標準的校準
請唸出單字：尺寸等允許偏差的範圍
請唸出：能反覆得到相應結果的程序
請唸出：功能上足以符合要求的結果
請唸出：精密不保證參照點正確
normal.ans: PRECISION DOES NOT GUARANTEE THAT THE REFERENCE POINT IS CORRECT
normal.speak: precision does not guarantee that the reference point is correct
normal.vocabId: R7:PRECISION DOES NOT GUARANTEE THAT THE REFERENCE POINT IS CORRECT

normal.desc: 請唸出：示例不必規定固定停止次數
normal.ans: AN ILLUSTRATION NEED NOT SPECIFY A FIXED STOPPING COUNT
normal.speak: an illustration need not specify a fixed stopping count
normal.vocabId: R7:AN ILLUSTRATION NEED NOT SPECIFY A FIXED STOPPING COUNT

normal.desc: 請拼出：相對兩側有對應相同形狀的（S 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：透過反覆循環修正進行的（I 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：在相應條件下可重現的（R 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：N O M _ N A L (作為名稱或標示而未必等於實際值的)
填空題：D E V _ A T _ O N (相對某標準的偏離)
填空題：A S _ M _ E _ R Y (兩側缺乏相同對應形狀的狀態)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 要求停止移動的每項命令
B. 只在船上才可見的裝飾
C. 列出付款總額的收據
D. 幫助判斷方向的線索
normal.explain: navigational cue 可指陸上空間尋路提示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 沒有阻礙而可順暢通行的路線
B. 全程受到遮蔽但不能通行的路線
C. 距離最短而不論有無障礙的路線
D. 只因名稱相同而被合併的路線
normal.explain: unimpeded 無阻，不保證最短或遮雨。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已測量且明白標出的路線距離
B. 外觀暗示的用途與實際可用方式不符
C. 完全看不見而毫無提示的資訊
D. 由所有使用者共同同意的新規則
normal.explain: affordance 此處指物件暗示可如何使用；misleading 為提示誤導。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The alternative entrance is open, though it is not listed under the name most visitors would think to search for.
options: A. 替代入口開著，但列名不是多數遊客會想到查的名稱。
B. 替代入口已關，只有原入口的名稱列在目錄。
C. 入口名稱人人熟悉，所以完全不需再做說明。
D. 說話者確認遊客不准搜尋其他入口名稱。
normal.explain: 實際可用與資訊可發現性不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have removed a physical barrier, not necessarily the uncertainty that makes people hesitate before entering.
options: A. 說話者認為只有熟客才應獲准進入。
B. 我們移除實體障礙，未必消除讓人進門前猶豫的不確定。
C. 實體障礙一移除，所有猶豫原因就已確定消失。
D. 不確定是由新障礙造成，因此原障礙從未移除。
normal.explain: 物理改善與資訊/心理門檻可分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The map assumes that people know which service they need by its official title, rather than by the problem they want solved.
options: A. 服務因沒有官方名稱，所以完全無法標在地圖。
B. 地圖只提供建物外觀，未曾提到任何服務。
C. 地圖預設人們知道服務官方名稱，而不是按待解問題尋找。
D. 地圖已依使用者問題分類，不需要任何官方名稱。
normal.explain: institution-centred 與 user-purpose 尋找差異。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The new queueing system reduces standing, though some users now find it harder to know when their turn is approaching.
options: A. 說話者認為站立減少就代表制度沒有任何缺點。
B. 新排隊制少站立，但部分人較難知道何時快輪到。
C. 新制度增加站立，卻讓每人都清楚自己次序。
D. 部分人完全不能領號，所以已正式被拒絕服務。
normal.explain: 改善某負擔與引入資訊需求並存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The problem is not that the information is absent, but that finding it requires the very familiarity the information is supposed to provide.
options: A. 所有資訊都缺漏，無論熟客新客都沒有任何可用線索。
B. 說話者只在質疑熟客是否應被提供更多優惠。
C. 問題非沒有資訊，而是找它先要具備它原本應提供的熟悉度。
D. 資訊已放在初訪者一眼可見處，所以只剩讀者不肯閱讀。
normal.explain: 找指引先需懂空間，形成取得資訊的循環門檻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A route described as direct can still involve a considerable detour for someone whose starting point the designer has not considered.
options: A. 路線只要名叫直接，就對所有起點同樣最短。
B. 設計者已逐一比較所有起點，所以不可能有繞路。
C. 起點不同已使每條路都永遠無法比較長度。
D. 設計者未考慮起點者，走所謂直接路線仍可能大繞路。
normal.explain: direct 的相對參照範圍要看起點，不否定可量比較。

normal.desc: 【語意】The route is legible to regular users but opaque to first-time visitors. What is being contrasted?
options: A. How clearly the map’s ink can be seen in different lighting.
B. How much regular users pay compared with first-time visitors.
C. How frequently the route is cleaned for each group of users.
D. How readily different users can understand the spatial arrangement.
normal.explain: legible/opaque 比喻空間可理解度，非印刷光線。

normal.desc: 【文法】The information should be placed where visitors ___ to choose between routes.
options: A. have
B. having
C. are have
D. had being
normal.explain: have to choose 表必須作選擇，where 引地點。

normal.desc: 【語用】The designer says the building encourages exploration. A visitor replies, I was trying to find the appointment I was already late for. What is challenged?
options: A. The visitor’s right to arrive before the appointment begins.
B. Treating difficulty in navigation as a benefit for every purpose.
C. The claim that appointments may be held in the building.
D. The possibility that some visitors enjoy exploring an unfamiliar place.
normal.explain: 探索優點依目的而異，趕預約者需要直接尋路。

normal.desc: 【文法】Not until visitors reach the junction ___ visible.
options: A. does the sign become
B. the sign becomes
C. becomes the sign does
D. the sign does becomes
normal.explain: Not until 前置引主句倒裝，does 後用 become。

normal.desc: 【短文】The map is accurate but oriented differently from the viewer’s position. Visitors repeatedly turn the wrong way. What revision addresses that specific difficulty?
options: A. Changing the names of rooms without changing the map’s orientation.
B. Aligning the map’s orientation with the viewer’s perspective.
C. Adding opening hours to every destination on the map.
D. Increasing the number of destinations listed alphabetically.
normal.explain: 錯在參照朝向，調朝向直接回應；準確標物件仍可能難用。

normal.desc: 【範圍】Assistance is available on request rather than automatically provided. What follows?
options: A. The service is unavailable to anyone who has booked.
B. Visitors must supply assistance to staff in return.
C. Visitors may need to ask before receiving it.
D. Every visitor will receive it without taking action.
normal.explain: on request 需提出要求，非主動自動提供。

normal.desc: 【短文】A directory groups services by department names. Visitors know what they need but not which department provides it. What information gap remains?
options: A. A description of how the building looked before it opened.
B. A connection between users’ purposes and institutional categories.
C. A complete list of department names in alphabetical order.
D. A record of how many staff work in each department.
normal.explain: 使用需求到部門名稱的映射不足，而非單純未列名稱。

normal.desc: 【短文】A centre measures route efficiency by distance alone. It omits queueing, locked gates and the time needed to locate the start. What should be reconsidered?
options: A. Whether every user should be required to arrive at the same time.
B. Whether the centre should remove every sign to reduce visual clutter.
C. Whether the measure captures the whole journey users must make.
D. Whether route distance can ever be measured consistently.
normal.explain: 效率量度漏掉實際時間要素，非距離毫無價值。

normal.desc: 【立場】The report supports a common route for all users but cautions against confusing identical routing with equivalent effort. What is the caution?
options: A. Any common route must be longer than every alternative route.
B. Equivalent effort requires everyone to move at the same speed.
C. Separate routes are always preferable regardless of their quality.
D. The same path may impose different demands on different people.
normal.explain: 同路線不保證同負擔，不先定共用或分離皆必優。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：環境或物件提供或暗示的可用方式
請唸出單字：進入某活動或空間前需跨過的門檻
請唸出：容易理解的空間層級
請唸出：容易找到資訊的替代選項
請唸出：能實際進入不保證感到被歡迎
normal.ans: PHYSICAL ENTRY DOES NOT GUARANTEE A SENSE OF WELCOME
normal.speak: physical entry does not guarantee a sense of welcome
normal.vocabId: R7:PHYSICAL ENTRY DOES NOT GUARANTEE A SENSE OF WELCOME

normal.desc: 請唸出：同路線可對不同使用者造成不同負擔
normal.ans: THE SAME ROUTE CAN IMPOSE DIFFERENT DEMANDS ON DIFFERENT USERS
normal.speak: the same route can impose different demands on different users
normal.vocabId: R7:THE SAME ROUTE CAN IMPOSE DIFFERENT DEMANDS ON DIFFERENT USERS

normal.desc: 請拼出：未受到妨礙而可順暢進行的（U 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：過於複雜曲折而難理解的（C 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：資訊或物件容易被找到的程度（F 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：B O T T L _ N E C K (限制通行流量的瓶頸位置)
填空題：C I R _ U I _ O U S (路線迂迴而不直接的)
填空題：S E _ L _ D _ D (遠離他人而較隱密的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以克制方式說出台詞
B. 把每句都大幅誇張說出的方式
C. 因音響故障而完全無聲
D. 只用書面而不作任何表演
normal.explain: understated 是低調節制，不等於聽不見。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 一律由最大聲者取得的角色
B. 展現高超技巧的傑出表現
C. 讓演出團隊巡迴的交通安排
D. 因體力不支而中斷的場次
normal.explain: tour de force 指令人讚嘆的技巧成就。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 演出前依序發出的正式公告
B. 每位觀眾都一致同意的結論
C. 與整體氣氛不協調的成分
D. 逐字準確記下的整頁筆記
normal.explain: discordant note 可比喻不搭調，不必是樂音。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The comic timing is precise, though it never feels as though the actors are counting the seconds.
options: A. 演員只要數秒就必然能使每位觀眾發笑。
B. 喜劇時機精準，但不讓人覺得演員在數秒。
C. 時機不精準，因演員每次都刻意數秒。
D. 表演自然已證明沒有任何計時或排練。
normal.explain: 精準與自然感並存，不推實際從未數秒。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I found the scene moving without quite believing the reconciliation it was supposed to portray.
options: A. 場景只是人物移動，所以不涉及和解。
B. 說話者因不信和解而否認演出有任何感染力。
C. 場景感人，但我未完全相信它所呈現的和解。
D. 我相信和解成立，但對場景完全沒有情感反應。
normal.explain: 情感感染與情節可信度可分離。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The actor makes the hesitation seem like a thought occurring now, not a pause learned on Tuesday.
options: A. 演員只在週二會停頓，其餘場次都直接答。
B. 遲疑是因演員忘詞，與角色思考無關。
C. 說話者要求週二停演，免得出現相同停頓。
D. 演員讓遲疑像此刻思緒，而非週二背好的停頓。
normal.explain: 幽默區分自然當下效果與排練製程。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The final laugh is less a release of tension than a recognition of how much tension the characters will carry away with them.
options: A. 角色離場時已向觀眾明說彼此不再有誤會。
B. 說話者認為笑聲必然表示觀眾沒理解劇情。
C. 最後笑聲較像認出角色仍帶走張力，而非張力已解除。
D. 最後笑聲證明角色間的所有緊張都已解決。
normal.explain: less ... than ... 指複雜笑聲功能，不是單純宣洩。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The production is clearest when it resists explaining itself, though that should not be mistaken for leaving the audience without anything to follow.
options: A. 演出越讓觀眾毫無線索，就越能保證清楚易懂。
B. 說話者要求把所有對話刪掉，只留下節目冊解說。
C. 演出已逐項說明全部象徵，所以沒有理解空間。
D. 演出不急著自我解說時反而最清楚，但不表示讓觀眾毫無線索。
normal.explain: 避免過度解說與提供可跟隨資訊並非互斥。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She never asks us to like the character, but she makes it difficult to dismiss the character as merely unpleasant.
options: A. 她不求我們喜歡角色，卻讓人難把角色簡化為討厭。
B. 她把角色寫得討喜，所以觀眾必須原諒所有行為。
C. 角色只有令人不快一面，演員也刻意不加層次。
D. 說話者認為不喜歡角色就不可能理解角色。
normal.explain: 理解人物複雜性不等於喜歡或替其開脫。

normal.desc: 【語意】The performance is assured without being predictable. What combination is praised?
options: A. Control that still allows surprise.
B. Confidence based on repeating every gesture identically.
C. Uncertainty that prevents any clear characterisation.
D. A familiar plot presented without variation in delivery.
normal.explain: assured 有把握穩健，不等於 predictable 可預料。

normal.desc: 【文法】The director asked that the final gesture ___ almost imperceptible.
options: A. to remain
B. remain
C. remains
D. remaining
normal.explain: asked that 虛擬式原形 remain，gesture 作單數主詞不加s。

normal.desc: 【語用】The critic says the actor lets us discover the joke rather than announcing where it is. What is praised?
options: A. A decision to remove every potentially funny line.
B. A habit of explaining the joke immediately after speaking.
C. An understated delivery that trusts the audience to infer.
D. A delivery so indistinct that the words cannot be heard.
normal.explain: 不明示笑點的克制詮釋，非含糊不清。

normal.desc: 【文法】The more restrained the opening, ___ the later outburst becomes.
options: A. the most striking of
B. the more striking
C. more striking than
D. so striking
normal.explain: the more ..., the more ... 表程度連動。

normal.desc: 【短文】The actor smiles while delivering a threat. The review argues that the smile does not soften the words but makes their courtesy unsettling. What effect is identified?
options: A. The smile proves that the character has no hostile intention.
B. The audience is instructed to ignore the spoken words.
C. A mismatch between manner and content intensifies unease.
D. The threat has been replaced by an explicit reassurance.
normal.explain: 禮貌與威脅的反差可加劇不安，不確定實際角色動機。

normal.desc: 【語意】The set is spare rather than unfinished. What distinction is made?
options: A. Missing scenery is excused because nobody has noticed it.
B. The set uses more objects than any previous production.
C. The performance has been cancelled before construction ends.
D. Deliberate economy is distinguished from incomplete work.
normal.explain: spare 簡約可為刻意選擇，不是未完工。

normal.desc: 【短文】An actor pauses after a question but before the reply. The director asks her to let the decision happen during the pause rather than signal a decision already made. What should change?
options: A. The question should be removed so no decision is required.
B. The actor should speak more loudly throughout the scene.
C. The pause should reveal deliberation, not merely delay delivery.
D. The actor should move the pause to after the spoken reply.
normal.explain: 停頓作當下思考與既定答案等待的表演差別。

normal.desc: 【短文】A production keeps the original words but changes who overhears them. A critic argues that this alters their dramatic function without rewriting the script. What supports the argument?
options: A. Dramatic function depends only on the number of words spoken.
B. Every change in staging necessarily introduces a new spoken line.
C. The identity of listeners matters only when they interrupt aloud.
D. The same speech can have different consequences depending on its listeners.
normal.explain: 聽者配置影響行動後果，不必改文字。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic welcomes ambiguity while objecting to confusion about which character is speaking. What distinction is maintained?
options: A. Interpretive openness need not require basic information to be unclear.
B. Every uncertain detail should be explained in the programme.
C. A clear speaker identity guarantees a single possible interpretation.
D. Ambiguity is valuable only when the dialogue cannot be heard.
normal.explain: 意思開放與辨識基本敘事資訊不同。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：意思或表達中細微的差異
請唸出單字：說話或聲音的節奏起伏
請唸出：刻意簡約的場景布置
請唸出：持續維持的情感張力
請唸出：歧義不必模糊誰在說話
normal.ans: AMBIGUITY NEED NOT OBSCURE WHO IS SPEAKING
normal.speak: ambiguity need not obscure who is speaking
normal.vocabId: R7:AMBIGUITY NEED NOT OBSCURE WHO IS SPEAKING

normal.desc: 請唸出：準備可支撐自發發現的觀感
normal.ans: PREPARATION CAN SUPPORT THE IMPRESSION OF SPONTANEOUS DISCOVERY
normal.speak: preparation can support the impression of spontaneous discovery
normal.vocabId: R7:PREPARATION CAN SUPPORT THE IMPRESSION OF SPONTANEOUS DISCOVERY

normal.desc: 請拼出：使人深受觸動而帶酸楚的（P 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：能引發深刻情感聯想的（R 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：細微到幾乎無法察覺的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：S U B _ E X T (字面下隱含而未明說的意思)
填空題：E N _ E M _ L E (共同演出的表演者群體)
填空題：R E _ T _ A _ N T (對表達或行動程度的克制)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 刻意提高衝突以促成決裂的表態
B. 意在和緩衝突的語氣
C. 不許對方再提異議的命令
D. 只在結算費用時使用的語氣
normal.explain: conciliatory 是求和不挑釁，未必放棄立場。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 帶著深切感謝的結尾
B. 未向任何人送出的私人草稿
C. 口氣斷然且不留商量的要求
D. 允許對方自由改寫的試探提議
normal.explain: peremptory request 可形式請求實質命令口吻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 毫無保留的同意並立即執行
B. 只因未收到訊息而沒有回覆
C. 公開斥責對方每項行為的聲明
D. 顧及對方感受的保留或異議
normal.explain: demurral 是有保留反對，tactful 不生硬。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The letter sounds formal, though the closing line suggests they know each other rather well.
options: A. 正式語氣已排除任何私人熟識關係。
B. 結尾要求雙方從此只用正式稱謂聯繫。
C. 信看來正式，但結尾暗示兩人相當熟。
D. 信只因兩人陌生而正式，結尾也證明從未見面。
normal.explain: 語域與關係可不一一對應，suggests 非身分確證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather decline clearly than leave you planning around a possibility I already know is remote.
options: A. 我想保留模糊答覆，因為越難確定越方便對方安排。
B. 我已確定能去，只是故意不給對方明確時間。
C. 對方已取消安排，所以我不需再回覆。
D. 我寧可清楚婉拒，不讓你圍著我已知很低的可能性安排。
normal.explain: 清晰拒絕可比虛留可能性更體貼。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apology takes responsibility for the delay, but remains rather guarded about the decision that caused it.
options: A. 道歉承擔延誤，對造成延誤的決策則較保留。
B. 道歉承認決策錯誤，但否認有任何延誤。
C. 道歉已公開完整說明所有決策細節並承擔全部責任。
D. 說話者認為只要延誤就不能再作任何決定。
normal.explain: 延誤結果與上游決策的承責程度不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation leaves the date to us, but the repeated mention of Saturday makes the freedom feel somewhat qualified.
options: A. 邀請已明令週六不得選，因此我們完全自由。
B. 反覆提週六已被確認只是日期印刷錯誤。
C. 說話者認為日期有任何建議就不可能協商。
D. 日期雖交我們選，反覆提週六讓自由似乎受限。
normal.explain: 明示自由與暗示偏好可有張力，somewhat 限程度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The phrase at your convenience is courteous, but the deadline two lines later makes clear that convenience has a fairly narrow window.
options: A. 方便時的客氣話受兩行後截止限制，實際時段不寬。
B. 信件讓對方任意決定何時答覆，完全沒有截止。
C. 截止只適用寄件者，所以收件者不需考慮。
D. 說話者要求把所有禮貌措辭從信中刪除。
normal.explain: 禮貌語句需與明示時間條件合讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He describes the request as a favour while referring to refusal as a failure to fulfil an obligation.
options: A. 說話者只討論 favour 這個字的拼寫差異。
B. 他把要求稱幫忙，卻把拒絕說成未盡義務。
C. 他清楚承認可拒絕，所以沒附任何道德期待。
D. 對方已自願接下正式責任，之後才說是在幫忙。
normal.explain: 請託自由與義務框架矛盾，未證已接責任。

normal.desc: 【語意】The reply is conciliatory without conceding the disputed point. What does it do?
options: A. It avoids both a position and any attempt to ease the tension.
B. It seeks to reduce tension while retaining the writer’s position.
C. It withdraws the writer’s position and demands an apology in return.
D. It intensifies the disagreement by refusing any further exchange.
normal.explain: conciliatory 和緩尋求和解，不必讓步爭點。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would appreciate ___ informed before any announcement is made.
options: A. be
B. been
C. being
D. to be
normal.explain: appreciate 後動名詞，being informed 為被告知。

normal.desc: 【語用】The writer says, I would not wish to impose, but leaves the recipient to propose several alternative dates. What might the recipient reasonably question?
options: A. Whether the writer has explicitly withdrawn the wish to meet.
B. Whether alternative dates can ever be proposed through correspondence.
C. Whether the recipient is expected to choose the writer’s destination.
D. Whether the effort of avoiding imposition has itself been transferred to them.
normal.explain: 不願打擾的表態仍可能把協調工作轉交對方；might 保留非必惡意。

normal.desc: 【文法】If convenient, I ___ grateful if you could confirm by Friday.
options: A. am been
B. will having
C. would be
D. had been
normal.explain: 半正式禮貌請求 I would be grateful if ...。

normal.desc: 【短文】An invitation describes attendance as entirely optional, then says an unexplained absence will be taken as a lack of commitment. What makes the choice less straightforward?
options: A. The date has been left open so no absence can be identified.
B. The writer has asked everyone to supply the same reason for attending.
C. The invitation has already been declined by all its recipients.
D. The stated freedom carries an implied negative judgement if exercised.
normal.explain: 形式自選附上不來的負面人格推論，形成壓力。

normal.desc: 【語意】The writer acknowledges the inconvenience without accepting that it was avoidable. Which statement is compatible?
options: A. The disruption mattered, but the writer does not concede it could have been prevented.
B. The disruption was preventable, but the writer denies that it affected anyone.
C. The writer accepts responsibility for preventing all future inconvenience.
D. The writer denies that the proposed arrangement ever changed.
normal.explain: 承認後果與承認可預防性/責任不相同。

normal.desc: 【語用】Perhaps I was not entirely clear is offered after the recipient objects to an ambiguous request. What is the most cautious interpretation?
options: A. The writer admits deliberately concealing the request’s purpose.
B. The recipient has now agreed to carry out the original request.
C. The writer confirms that the request has been formally withdrawn.
D. The writer accepts some responsibility for lack of clarity.
normal.explain: perhaps/not entirely 限定承認程度，未證明蓄意或撤請求。

normal.desc: 【短文】A correspondent says she seeks advice, but describes every alternative to her preferred plan as impractical before asking for a response. What should the recipient notice?
options: A. The apparent openness is narrowed by how the options are framed.
B. The writer has promised to adopt whichever plan the recipient proposes.
C. Every alternative has been independently tested under the same conditions.
D. The request is solely for information about the plans’ historical origins.
normal.explain: 求建議卻先否定替代框架，不必證已完整測試。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The refusal applies to sharing the draft publicly, not to discussing its ideas privately. Which response respects that distinction?
options: A. Publish a summary and describe it as the complete draft.
B. Arrange a private discussion without circulating the draft publicly.
C. Send the draft to a public group but ask them not to comment.
D. Assume the ideas may never be discussed in any setting.
normal.explain: 明示區分公開流傳與私下討論，不新增絕對禁止。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：對某提議提出的保留或異議
請唸出單字：以迂迴長句避開直接說法的表達
請唸出：帶保留而不全然放心的接受
請唸出：範圍被仔細限定的承諾
請唸出：確認收到不代表支持提案
normal.ans: ACKNOWLEDGING RECEIPT DOES NOT ENDORSE THE PROPOSAL
normal.speak: acknowledging receipt does not endorse the proposal
normal.vocabId: R7:ACKNOWLEDGING RECEIPT DOES NOT ENDORSE THE PROPOSAL

normal.desc: 請唸出：溫暖結尾未必解決實際問題
normal.ans: A WARM CLOSING NEED NOT SETTLE A PRACTICAL QUESTION
normal.speak: a warm closing need not settle a practical question
normal.vocabId: R7:A WARM CLOSING NEED NOT SETTLE A PRACTICAL QUESTION

normal.desc: 請拼出：意在和緩衝突促成和解的（C 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：斷然命令而不容商量的（P 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：不明確表態或承諾的（N 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：S A L U T _ T I O N (信件開頭的稱呼語)
填空題：R E C _ P I _ N T (接收信件物品或訊息的人)
填空題：I M _ O S _ T _ O N (對他人造成的額外負擔或打擾)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 沒有任何高度差的平面
B. 只存在地圖比例中的虛線
C. 像波浪般緩緩起伏的地景
D. 每面都完全垂直的山壁
normal.explain: undulating是連續起伏，非鋸齒式尖峰。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 每色都極強烈對比的配色
B. 已完全無法辨認的黑影
C. 只用來降低聲音的設備
D. 色彩柔和而不張揚的配色
normal.explain: palette色彩組合，muted低調柔和。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 短暫閃現的明亮感
B. 永不變化的固定尺寸
C. 因完全無光而形成的黑暗
D. 只能用聲音辨識的變化
normal.explain: fleeting轉瞬，luminosity亮度或發光感。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The hills looked smooth at a distance, though the path under our feet told a rather different story.
options: A. 遠處山丘崎嶇，腳下道路則已確定全平。
B. 小路上的文字明確記錄了山丘的歷史。
C. 說話者認為遠處與近處外觀必定完全一致。
D. 遠看山丘平滑，腳下路況卻不像那麼平順。
normal.explain: told different story比喻近看地面與遠景差異。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would describe the scene as austere, not lifeless; the few movements seemed to matter more because there were so few.
options: A. 場景簡樸冷峻而非無生氣，動作少使每個更顯重要。
B. 場景因動作少而被確定完全沒有生命存在。
C. 說話者主張加入更多人物才能讓畫面有意義。
D. 每個動作都太多，所以無法辨認任何變化。
normal.explain: 稀少不等於全無，節制可凸顯細節。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The sound was distant enough to be reassuringly ordinary, rather than something that required us to turn and look.
options: A. 只有完全沒聲音，才可能感到日常的安心。
B. 聲音夠遠，像安心的日常背景，而非需回頭查看的事。
C. 聲音近到令人驚嚇，所以大家立刻回頭。
D. 說話者已查出聲音來源，保證任何時候都無風險。
normal.explain: 敘述當下感受，非客觀安全保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The path appeared to end at the wall, but a turn concealed by the hedge carried it on behind the houses.
options: A. 路看似在牆邊止，樹籬遮住的彎其實通往房後。
B. 路確實止在牆邊，房後完全沒有延伸。
C. 樹籬已拆除，所以原來的路也被取消。
D. 說話者走進房內，才知道牆上畫著一條路。
normal.explain: 視線中斷不等於實際路線中斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What I remember as silence may be the absence of the sounds I was used to, rather than the absence of sound.
options: A. 只要聲音不熟悉，就不可能留下記憶。
B. 記憶中的寂靜可能是沒有熟悉噪音，不是真無聲。
C. 地方已經儀器測量，證明沒有任何頻率聲響。
D. 說話者完全失去聽力，因此聽不見熟悉聲音。
normal.explain: silence相對個人聲景，may保留反思。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The description becomes intimate just when the view becomes least extensive: we stop surveying the valley and notice the rain in a single leaf.
options: A. 葉子把山谷擋住，所以作者無法再作任何描述。
B. 說話者認為任何親近描述都不應出現自然細節。
C. 視野不再遼闊時描寫反而親近，從山谷轉看單葉雨水。
D. 描述因視野愈廣才愈私人，最後仍只列山谷總面積。
normal.explain: 尺度由全景到近物，親密感不等同廣闊。

normal.desc: 【語意】The hills are undulating rather than sharply jagged. Which image fits?
options: A. A perfectly level surface without any variation.
B. A single vertical wall cutting off the view.
C. A succession of gently rising and falling forms.
D. A row of abrupt pointed peaks with steep edges.
normal.explain: undulating 起伏如波，與jagged尖銳不規則對比。

normal.desc: 【文法】The valley lay below us, its cottages ___ to small pale marks.
options: A. reducing
B. had reduced
C. were reduce
D. reduced
normal.explain: 獨立結構 cottages reduced to...，在遠視中被縮成小點。

normal.desc: 【氣氛】The sun had gone, but the windows retained a last improbable gold. What does improbable contribute?
options: A. The lingering brightness feels unexpectedly vivid.
B. The narrator has proved the windows are made of gold.
C. The sunset is denied as an event that could have occurred.
D. The cottages have been described as physically impossible to reach.
normal.explain: improbable修飾印象令人意外，不是判物理不可能。

normal.desc: 【文法】Only after the wind dropped ___ how far the bell could be heard.
options: A. we realised
B. had realised we
C. we did realised
D. did we realise
normal.explain: Only after 前置，主句did倒裝接realise原形。

normal.desc: 【短文】The traveller describes the sea as patient, returning to the same stones after each retreat. What does the personification foreground?
options: A. Repetition that feels steady rather than hurried.
B. The traveller’s measurement of how long each wave lasts.
C. Evidence that the stones have consciously refused to move.
D. A promise that the sea will remain calm throughout the year.
normal.explain: patient以反覆回到石邊的規律賦情緒，非科學測量。

normal.desc: 【語意】The colours are muted, but the scene is not dull. What distinction is preserved?
options: A. The narrator finds both the colour and the experience monotonous.
B. Low colour intensity need not mean lack of interest.
C. A scene needs bright colour before it can contain detail.
D. The colours have been lost because the picture is damaged.
normal.explain: muted 柔和低飽和，dull可指乏味；兩者不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】The mist was thin enough ___ the outline, but not the details, to emerge.
options: A. for
B. that
C. as
D. of
normal.explain: enough for + 名詞 + to emerge，明示輪廓可見細節未見。

normal.desc: 【短文】A narrator calls a valley untouched, then notices terraces, repaired walls and paths worn into the grass. The description shifts from wilderness to long habitation. What changes?
options: A. The paths are proved to have formed without people or animals ever passing.
B. The narrator recognises human work within what first appeared purely natural.
C. The landscape has been physically rebuilt during the few moments of observation.
D. The narrator concludes that no natural features remain anywhere in the valley.
normal.explain: 新細節改解讀，非現場瞬間改建。

normal.desc: 【氣氛】The station clock was the only thing in the village that seemed in a hurry. What does the contrast suggest?
options: A. The village has formally abolished schedules for every resident.
B. Nobody in the village is able to read a clock face.
C. The place feels slow-paced despite the clock’s regular movement.
D. The clock has been measured and found to run dangerously fast.
normal.explain: 擬人in a hurry反襯慢節奏印象，非檢測走快。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：較亮背景前顯出的深色輪廓
請唸出單字：寬廣延伸的一片空間
請唸出：如半透明薄紗般的霧
請唸出：不斷轉變的觀看角度
請唸出：遠景平滑可能遮掉崎嶇小路
normal.ans: A DISTANT SMOOTHNESS MAY CONCEAL A ROUGH PATH
normal.speak: a distant smoothness may conceal a rough path
normal.vocabId: R7:A DISTANT SMOOTHNESS MAY CONCEAL A ROUGH PATH

normal.desc: 請唸出：光留在高處窗戶
normal.ans: THE LIGHT LINGERED IN THE UPPER WINDOWS
normal.speak: the light lingered in the upper windows
normal.vocabId: R7:THE LIGHT LINGERED IN THE UPPER WINDOWS

normal.desc: 請拼出：像波浪般上下起伏的（U 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：可透光但不能清楚看穿的（T 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：明亮或彷彿發光的（L 開頭，8 個字母）
填空題：H A _ E (使遠景不清楚的薄霧或濛氣)
填空題：M _ T _ D (色彩聲音等被減弱而不張揚的)
填空題：R A _ I _ N _ E (明亮而向外散發的光輝)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已經過所有主管逐一簽核
B. 完全不許退回或再作選擇
C. 只要有人稱讚就必須購買
D. 先試看或檢視後再決定是否接受
normal.explain: on approval在供貨語境指試看再決定，具體條件需另看約定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以舊物折抵部分新物價款的交易
B. 只買零件而不買完整物件
C. 兩人各持物品一半且不能移動
D. 把全部價款分配給運送者
normal.explain: part exchange為舊物抵新物部分價，不指定真實交易規則。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只能使用製造者最早的版本
B. 適合原先要達成的用途
C. 外觀必須符合每個人的喜好
D. 價格必須在所有選項中最低
normal.explain: 此處一般語意為用途適合，不下法律判斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The sample was supplied for comparison, not as a promise that every unit would have exactly the same grain.
options: A. 樣品供比較，不保證每件紋理完全同樣。
B. 樣品已被保證是所有單品紋理的精確複製。
C. 樣品只用秤重，所以不能比較任何外觀。
D. 每件紋理不同已證明所有物件都用不同材質。
normal.explain: 實物自然變異與示例保證範圍不同，未說材質種類。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The question is not whether the substitute is good, but whether the feature it lacks is the one that made the original useful to us.
options: A. 說話者只關心替代品是否來自同一包裝。
B. 問題非替代品好不好，而是它缺的是否正是原品對我們有用之處。
C. 替代品既然評價好，就不必比較缺少的功能。
D. 原品已被證明完全沒有任何實用功能。
normal.explain: 按需求比較特徵，不用總評取代適配。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A longer list of features can make comparison harder, especially when the features we care about are described in different terms.
options: A. 說話者認為比較只需數功能項目，不必看意思。
B. 所有功能表已被確認逐字相同，所以無從比較。
C. 功能表較長未必好比，尤其關鍵功能用不同詞描述時。
D. 功能愈多就已保證各品牌使用同樣詞彙。
normal.explain: 命名與資訊量可增比較負擔，非所有功能皆無用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The exchange was equal by count, though one person gave away three things they no longer needed and received three they did.
options: A. 說話者認為只要一方受益就必定另一方受害。
B. 件數相等，但一方把不需的三件換成需要的三件。
C. 件數不等，因有用物在規則中一律算兩件。
D. 雙方已確認每件物市場價完全相同。
normal.explain: 計件相等與主觀效益不同，不推零和。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Calling the extra item free overlooks the condition that we buy a set larger than we intended to own.
options: A. 組合較大已證明每件都比原先品質差。
B. 說話者認為任何贈品都一定涉及違法。
C. 說加送免費忽略前提：需買比原想更多的一組。
D. 加送不附任何條件，所以與購買量完全無關。
normal.explain: 免費字面未含整體購買門檻，非真實購物建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The programme encourages reuse, but its success should not depend on passing unsuitable objects to someone who feels obliged to be grateful.
options: A. 只要物件轉手，就已足以證明受贈者需要它。
B. 感謝已保證對方願意長期存放任何物件。
C. 說話者反對所有再利用，不論是否符合需求。
D. 鼓勵再用不應靠把不適合物件給覺得必須感謝的人。
normal.explain: 再利用目的與收受者適配/負擔並檢，不全盤否定。

normal.desc: 【語意】The alternative is comparable in price, not interchangeable in use. What is clarified?
options: A. Identical functions guarantee an identical selling price.
B. The alternative has no price and no identifiable purpose.
C. The two items must be used together because they cost the same.
D. Similar cost does not establish functional equivalence.
normal.explain: comparableprice與interchangeableuse兩種比較尺度不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】The assistant suggested ___ the smaller version before ordering a second set.
options: A. trying
B. to trying
C. try it
D. that trying
normal.explain: suggest後動名詞trying，before表示先試再訂。

normal.desc: 【語用】The customer says, I need it to do less, but do it reliably. What preference is expressed?
options: A. The lowest price without regard to the stated purpose.
B. Dependable core function over numerous extra features.
C. A larger range of features regardless of consistency.
D. A device that does nothing so it cannot fail.
normal.explain: 少功能但穩定，非完全不用或只看價。

normal.desc: 【文法】The colour is the only respect in ___ the replacement differs.
options: A. which
B. that
C. whose
D. what
normal.explain: in which 接介系詞關係子句，respect為方面。

normal.desc: 【短文】A buyer asks for a quieter model. The seller recommends one described as more powerful, without giving noise information. What gap remains?
options: A. The recommendation can be assessed solely by comparing model names.
B. The recommendation has not addressed the buyer’s stated criterion.
C. The buyer has established that power and noise are the same property.
D. The seller has proved that the more powerful model is quieter.
normal.explain: 用另一賣點回應未回答低噪需求。

normal.desc: 【語意】The offer is attractive in isolation but less so once the required accessories are included. What changes the assessment?
options: A. The offer has been withdrawn before any comparison can be made.
B. The buyer is required to ignore accessories in calculating usefulness.
C. The relevant total extends beyond the advertised item.
D. The accessories remove the need to buy the main item.
normal.explain: 完整成本/需求含必要配件，非只有主件。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am not questioning the quality; I am questioning whether it is the right answer to the problem we described. What is challenged?
options: A. The need to describe the problem before selecting a product.
B. The relevance of the recommendation.
C. The possibility that the product was manufactured.
D. The honesty of everyone who has used it.
normal.explain: 品質佳仍可能不適用特定問題。

normal.desc: 【短文】A trial tests a container while it is empty, though the intended use involves carrying fragile objects. A review calls the trial reassuring but incomplete. Why?
options: A. Fragile objects are guaranteed to break in every container.
B. The intended use has changed from storage to manufacturing.
C. The conditions omit a feature central to the intended use.
D. An empty container cannot provide any information about its physical form.
normal.explain: 空箱試驗未涵實際載物情境，保留部分資訊價值。

normal.desc: 【立場】The review treats repairability as distinct from the mere availability of replacement parts. What additional question matters?
options: A. Whether replacement parts have names different from the original parts.
B. Whether the item is offered in more than one decorative colour.
C. Whether every owner purchased the item on the same calendar date.
D. Whether the parts can realistically be fitted by the intended users or service.
normal.explain: 有配件還需能實際裝配維修，不推人人應自行修。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：一同寄往某地的一批貨物
請唸出單字：物件實際可被修好的程度
請唸出：功能上相當的替代品
請唸出：實際可行的修復可能性
請唸出：價格相近不證成功能可互換
normal.ans: COMPARABLE PRICES DO NOT ESTABLISH INTERCHANGEABLE FUNCTIONS
normal.speak: comparable prices do not establish interchangeable functions
normal.vocabId: R7:COMPARABLE PRICES DO NOT ESTABLISH INTERCHANGEABLE FUNCTIONS

normal.desc: 請唸出：備件適合相關版本才有用
normal.ans: A SPARE IS USEFUL ONLY WHEN IT FITS THE RELEVANT VERSION
normal.speak: a spare is useful only when it fits the relevant version
normal.vocabId: R7:A SPARE IS USEFUL ONLY WHEN IT FITS THE RELEVANT VERSION

normal.desc: 請拼出：能在同一用途下彼此替代的（I 開頭，15 個字母）
請拼出：以憑證換取約定物品或利益的兌換（R 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：整修使用過的物件使其恢復良好狀態（R 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：R E F U R B _ S H M E N T (為改善狀況而進行的翻新整修)
填空題：I N D _ C E _ E N T (促使某人採取行動的誘因)
填空題：S U B _ T I _ U T _ O N (以另一物代替原物的行為)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 逐項排除不符可能性的過程
B. 把所有原始紀錄銷毀的程序
C. 只挑最喜歡答案而不比較的方法
D. 無論線索如何都維持首答的做法
normal.explain: elimination在推理語境排除候選，不是刪紀錄。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因設備正在運轉而不需查核的說法
B. 暫作推理依據而仍待檢驗的假設
C. 已由定義證明不可更改的結論
D. 只談工作時間的正式合約
normal.explain: working表示暫供使用，不等於已確證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已被承認是捏造的每項指控
B. 只因篇幅短就不需核對的便條
C. 支持間接推論的一項情況證據
D. 逐字錄下行為的直接影像
normal.explain: 間接不自動假，也不必由影像直接展示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We know the drawer was opened; the mark does not tell us whether that happened before or after the letter arrived.
options: A. 信件到達已保證抽屜當時保持未開。
B. 知道抽屜開過，痕跡不告訴在信到前還後。
C. 痕跡已證抽屜只在信到之前開過一次。
D. 我們不知道抽屜曾否打開，但知道確切時刻。
normal.explain: 事件存在與順序資訊分離。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Her knowledge is surprising only if we assume she had not read the announcement everyone else received.
options: A. 公告內容已被確定與她知道的事完全無關。
B. 說話者確認她從未收到任何形式的資訊。
C. 只有假設她未讀別人都收到的公告，她知道才顯意外。
D. 她已承認讀過公告，所以知道反而證明說謊。
normal.explain: 意外程度依先備資訊假設，未證她確已讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The witness corrects the time, not the event; we should not turn a corrected detail into a withdrawal of the whole account.
options: A. 改時間已等於承認事件從未發生。
B. 整份說法已正式撤回，只剩時間仍被保留。
C. 說話者要求所有更正都不需被記錄。
D. 目擊者改時間非事件，不應把細節更正當全部撤回。
normal.explain: 更正範圍與整段撤回不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The extra key explains how someone could enter, but not why the person who had it would choose to do so.
options: A. 鑰匙已被確定無法使用，所以不解釋任何可能。
B. 說話者只在問鑰匙的製造材料。
C. 多一把鑰匙解釋能怎麼進，不解釋持有者為何會進。
D. 有鑰匙已充分證明持有者一定想進且進過。
normal.explain: 機會/能力與動機/實行分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The theory becomes less impressive once we notice how many facts it predicts only after they have been supplied.
options: A. 理論在事前逐項正確預測，所以特別可靠。
B. 說話者否認事後解釋可有任何理解價值。
C. 事實從未被提供，所以理論無從調整。
D. 注意到多項預測是在事實給出後才作，理論便不那麼厲害。
normal.explain: 事後配合不等同事前預測力，非否認全部解釋價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We should preserve the difference between what the character could have known and what the story actually tells us she knew.
options: A. 應保留角色可能知道與故事明說她知道的差別。
B. 角色有機會知道就已確定實際知道。
C. 故事沒說知道就已確定她不可能知道。
D. 說話者只在區分角色名字與作者名字。
normal.explain: 可能知情非必實際知情，也不因未明說就必不知。

normal.desc: 【語意】The evidence is circumstantial rather than a direct account of the act. What does this mean?
options: A. It supports an inference through surrounding facts.
B. It records the act through an eyewitness description.
C. It has been proved false by the person concerned.
