B. It makes the task appear less demanding than its written specification.
C. It presents willingness to discuss as acceptance of responsibility.
D. It presents a completed task as though it had not yet started.
boss.explain: 同意討論不等於接責任，感謝式措辭可能預置承諾。

boss.desc: 請唸出：未明說但暗示需回應的義務
boss.speak: an implied obligation to respond

boss.desc: 請唸出：願意討論不應被轉述為同意
boss.ans: WILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS SHOULD NOT BE REPORTED AS CONSENT
boss.speak: willingness to discuss should not be reported as consent
boss.vocabId: R7:WILLINGNESS TO DISCUSS SHOULD NOT BE REPORTED AS CONSENT

boss.desc: 請拼出：明確界定某事的範圍（D 開頭，7 個字母）
boss.speak: delimit

boss.desc: 填空題：D E _ E R _ N T _ A L (因尊重對方而顯得恭順的)
boss.speak: deferential

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The water looked opaque from above, then suddenly translucent when the light came through from the side.
options: A. 側光使水由透明變成完全黑暗而非半透明。
B. 水從上看不透，側光穿來時卻突然半透明。
C. 水一直完全不透光，側光也沒有任何影響。
D. 說話者把水換成玻璃，所以透明程度改變。
boss.explain: 視角與光照改變水的表觀，未改物質本身。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The evening did not darken evenly; the fields lost their colour while the upper windows seemed to hold the light.
options: A. 田野保持明亮，而高處窗是最早全暗。
B. 說話者確認窗戶把太陽實體留在室內。
C. 天色非均勻暗下，田野失色而高處窗似留住光。
D. 所有地方同時變成同亮度，沒有任何局部差異。
boss.explain: 描述不均光影變化，hold light為比喻。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The place feels remote, though the traffic we can just hear beyond the ridge prevents remoteness from becoming a claim that the world has disappeared.
options: A. 地方被證實與所有道路斷絕，車聲只在記憶中。
B. 車聲太大已完全消除偏遠感，作者不再有任何距離感。
C. 說話者把山脊外世界描述為真實地從地球上消失。
D. 地方感覺偏遠，但山脊外微弱車聲仍提醒外界存在。
boss.explain: 遠隔感與外界提示共存，非絕對隔離。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A silhouette shows primarily ___.
options: A. a coloured diagram with measurements marked
B. a dark outline against a lighter background
C. the precise texture of every visible surface
D. a reflection viewed only through moving water
boss.explain: silhouette 逆光剪影或輪廓，非細部紋理。

boss.desc: 【視角】At first the distant shapes seemed to drift. When I leaned against the wall, they settled: it was the boat beneath me that had been moving. What is revised?
options: A. The boat’s original destination.
B. The number of shapes visible in the distance.
C. The apparent source of motion.
D. The identity of the wall’s builder.
boss.explain: 原以遠物動，後知自身船動造成相對視覺。

boss.desc: 【短文】The account lingers on a gate’s worn latch while mentioning the famous view in a single sentence. Which reading is best supported?
options: A. The traveller was unable to see any part of the view.
B. The latch is officially listed as the region’s most famous attraction.
C. The account has accidentally omitted the view from its pages.
D. The traveller’s attention favours intimate detail over the expected landmark.
boss.explain: 敘述篇幅揭注意焦點，未證看不到景或官方評價。

boss.desc: 請唸出：簡樸冷峻的美
boss.speak: an austere beauty

boss.desc: 請唸出：親近細節能取代遼闊景觀
boss.ans: AN INTIMATE DETAIL CAN REPLACE AN EXTENSIVE VIEW
boss.speak: an intimate detail can replace an extensive view
boss.vocabId: R7:AN INTIMATE DETAIL CAN REPLACE AN EXTENSIVE VIEW

boss.desc: 請拼出：帶有沉靜憂傷情緒的（M 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: melancholy

boss.desc: 填空題：S P _ R S _ N _ S S (數量稀少且分布疏落的狀態)
boss.speak: sparseness

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The accessory is optional for storage, but essential if you want to carry the case by its handle.
options: A. 配件只為裝飾，無任何功能差別。
B. 說話者已取消所有帶把手版本。
C. 只存放不需配件，但要用把手提就必需。
D. 配件無論存放或提走都完全不需。
boss.explain: optional/essential依用途條件不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would regard the spare as reassurance only if we know which version it fits; a spare we cannot use is simply another thing to store.
options: A. 只要名叫備件就確保能用在每個版本。
B. 備件無法收納，因此任何時候都不應保留。
C. 說話者確認目前備件一定與所需版本不合。
D. 知道備件適用版本才安心，不能用的只多占收納。
boss.explain: if為評估條件，未已確認不相容。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The cheaper version saves money only on the assumption that replacing it more often will not erase the initial difference.
options: A. 較廉版本是否省錢取決於較常替換不會抵消初價差。
B. 初價低已保證任何期間的總成本都較低。
C. 較常替換已證明兩版本在每項功能都相同。
D. 說話者確認目前版本已壞，所以不能再比較價格。
boss.explain: 初價與累計成本條件區分，不提供真實財務結論。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A consignment is ___.
options: A. a discount applied automatically to every purchase
B. a request to repair an item without returning it
C. a quantity of goods sent together to a destination
D. a customer’s private opinion about a product
boss.explain: consignment為一批託運/寄送貨物。

boss.desc: 【範圍】The shop’s fictional notice allows exchange for another size only if the item is unworn and returned within seven days. Which case meets both stated conditions?
options: A. A worn item returned after two days.
B. An unworn item returned after nine days.
C. A worn item kept for exactly seven days.
D. An unworn item returned after five days.
boss.explain: 題內兩必要條件and連用，非真實退換貨法律說明。

boss.desc: 【短文】A borrowing scheme counts success by how many items circulate, but not whether borrowers find suitable items or return repeatedly. What is the measurement’s limitation?
options: A. Transaction volume does not fully describe the service’s usefulness.
B. More circulation necessarily makes a borrowing scheme less useful.
C. The scheme cannot record circulation without identifying every object’s maker.
D. Borrowers’ satisfaction can be inferred exactly from the number of labels.
boss.explain: 流量不代表適配/長期效用全部，非流量毫無價值。

boss.desc: 請唸出：帶條件保留的適用性保證
boss.speak: a qualified assurance of suitability

boss.desc: 請唸出：相同件數可能掩蓋不同效益
boss.ans: AN EQUAL COUNT CAN CONCEAL DIFFERENT KINDS OF BENEFIT
boss.speak: an equal count can conceal different kinds of benefit
boss.vocabId: R7:AN EQUAL COUNT CAN CONCEAL DIFFERENT KINDS OF BENEFIT

boss.desc: 請拼出：逐漸過時而不再適用的狀態或過程（O 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: obsolescence

boss.desc: 填空題：S U _ T A _ I L _ T Y (適合特定用途或情境的程度)
boss.speak: suitability

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The detail is consistent with her account, but it is not distinctive enough to identify her as the only possible source.
options: A. 細節已排除所有他人，所以來源確定唯一。
B. 細節完全與她矛盾，故她從未說過任何話。
C. 說話者認為只要一致就不可能再查來源。
D. 細節符合她說法，但不足獨特到確定唯一來源是她。
boss.explain: 相容與唯一識別力不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would call the result inconclusive, not exonerating: it leaves the question open rather than answering it in her favour.
options: A. 結果未定論，非替她洗清；問題仍開放而非已判對她有利。
B. 結果已替她洗清，但只是缺少公開聲明。
C. 結果未定論就已證她一定做過此事。
D. 說話者確認不存在任何需要回答的問題。
boss.explain: 未確定與肯定無責任不同，也不等於有責任。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The apparent contradiction disappears if the two accounts refer to different doors, but we still need evidence that they do.
options: A. 說話者要求只保留最短說法以免出現矛盾。
B. 若兩說指不同門，矛盾可消；但仍需證據確有不同所指。
C. 既能想像不同門，就已證兩說必定一致。
D. 兩說已確認指同門，因此任何細節都無需再比。
boss.explain: 可調和假設與假設已成立分開。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A deduction is ___.
options: A. a detail introduced solely to make a story more entertaining
B. a statement that cannot be revised under any circumstances
C. an object removed from a room without anyone noticing
D. a conclusion reached by reasoning from what is known
boss.explain: deduction推理所得結論，此語境非扣款。

boss.desc: 【語意】The new detail qualifies the explanation without overturning it. What happens?
options: A. Its scope or certainty is reduced, but it is not wholly rejected.
B. Its central claim is replaced by the opposite claim.
C. Its wording is made more formal without any change of meaning.
D. Its author is confirmed as professionally qualified.
boss.explain: qualify限定，非資格或必推翻。

boss.desc: 【短文】A character calls an unexpected clue a distraction because it does not fit his theory. He has not investigated it. What risks circular reasoning?
options: A. Changing a theory after discovering an incompatible fact.
B. Using the theory to dismiss evidence, then citing the remaining fit as support.
C. Comparing the theory with facts that were recorded before it was proposed.
D. Keeping track of which details require further explanation.
boss.explain: 用理論篩證再以被篩證自證，非所有刪細節皆循環。

boss.desc: 請唸出：尚未解釋的不一致
boss.speak: an unexplained discrepancy

boss.desc: 請唸出：可能調和仍需支持證據
boss.ans: A POSSIBLE RECONCILIATION STILL REQUIRES SUPPORTING EVIDENCE
boss.speak: a possible reconciliation still requires supporting evidence
boss.vocabId: R7:A POSSIBLE RECONCILIATION STILL REQUIRES SUPPORTING EVIDENCE

boss.desc: 請拼出：尚未充分證實的推測（C 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: conjecture

boss.desc: 填空題：O V E _ S I _ P L _ F Y (把複雜情況解釋得過於簡單)
boss.speak: oversimplify

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The exception applies to the next move, not to every move you make while holding the card.
options: A. 例外只適用下一步，不是持卡期間每步。
B. 例外持卡期間一直有效，沒有次數限制。
C. 卡不影響任何一步，只改最後分數。
D. 例外已追溯到玩家先前全部行動。
boss.explain: next單一行動與持有狀態期間不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would call it an exploit of the wording rather than a strategy the examples appear designed to encourage.
options: A. 只要能從文字讀出，就已等於設計者明確鼓勵。
B. 我會稱利用措辭漏洞，而非示例看來鼓勵的策略。
C. 這是示例已明示必須採取的唯一策略。
D. 說話者已證實該行動被明文禁止。
boss.explain: 文字可容與設計意圖推測不同，非直接定違規。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The extra move is valuable only if taking it does not trigger the penalty that makes stopping the better option.
options: A. 說話者已明說每次多走都一定被處罰。
B. 停手在此被定義為立即取消整局勝利資格。
C. 額外步有價值的前提是不觸發讓停手更好的處罰。
D. 只要可多走，觸發任何處罰都不影響價值。
boss.explain: 需比較條件代價，非多一步無條件好。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A countermove is ___.
options: A. an action responding strategically to another action
B. a token removed because its colour has faded
C. a move made before the game’s rules are explained
D. an accidental action that has no effect on play
boss.explain: countermove反制回應，不是桌面counter棋片之移動而已。

boss.desc: 【短文】A game gives players unequal starting resources but different targets intended to balance the challenge. A reviewer asks whether the targets actually compensate. What is under examination?
options: A. Whether the reviewer has memorised every possible game sequence.
B. The relation between initial advantages and the demands of winning.
C. Whether unequal resources must look identical in shape and colour.
D. The assumption that every player should draw the same card every turn.
boss.explain: 起資源不等與勝利難度是否補償需實際評估，不預定平衡。

boss.desc: 【短文】A team’s strategy depends on a promise another team can revoke without penalty. The promise has been sincere so far. What vulnerability remains?
options: A. A revocable promise cannot ever be made sincerely.
B. The plan requires both teams to have identical scores.
C. The plan relies on cooperation that the rules do not secure.
D. Past sincerity proves that future withdrawal is impossible.
boss.explain: 意圖真誠與制度約束穩定性不同。

boss.desc: 請唸出：仍可能改變的暫時聯盟
boss.speak: a provisional alliance

boss.desc: 請唸出：真誠承諾依規則仍可能可撤回
boss.ans: A SINCERE PROMISE MAY REMAIN REVOCABLE UNDER THE RULES
boss.speak: a sincere promise may remain revocable under the rules
boss.vocabId: R7:A SINCERE PROMISE MAY REMAIN REVOCABLE UNDER THE RULES

boss.desc: 請拼出：使一般規則在特定情況讓位的凌駕（O 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.speak: override

boss.desc: 填空題：A L _ O C _ T _ O N (把資源分派給不同用途或對象的安排)
boss.speak: allocation

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: She is precise about the order but hesitant about the year, so I would keep those two kinds of confidence separate.
options: A. 說話者認為任何回憶只能整體全信或全不信。
B. 她對順序精確、年份卻遲疑，應分開看兩種把握。
C. 她既知順序，就已確定每個事件的精確年份。
D. 年份遲疑已使順序記憶完全不可能準確。
boss.explain: 不同記憶面向可有不同確定度。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The apparent contradiction may be between two stages of her life, not between two statements about the same stage.
options: A. 只要提不同年份，所有內容都自動一致。
B. 說話者已證明受訪者從未改變任何想法。
C. 表面矛盾可能來自人生兩階段，而非同階段兩說。
D. 兩說已確認同時，因此不需再看時間。
boss.explain: 時間視角可解張力，但may非已證。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The qualification belongs beside the quotation, not in a separate note that readers are unlikely to connect with it.
options: A. 限定完全無關引文，所以應永久刪除。
B. 只要有另註，就已保證每位讀者能正確連結。
C. 說話者只關心字體大小而不關心資訊關係。
D. 限定應緊靠引文，不放讀者不易連上的另註。
boss.explain: 資訊位置影響限定能否發揮詮釋作用。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To elicit a response is to ___.
options: A. exclude it because it does not fit a theory
B. draw it out through a question or stimulus
C. guarantee that it is factually accurate
D. rewrite it without retaining the speaker’s words
boss.explain: elicit引出，不保證真或改寫。

boss.desc: 【範圍】The interviewee permits quotation on condition that the passage about another person is excluded. What is not authorised by that permission?
options: A. Keeping track of which passage has been excluded.
B. Asking whether the condition applies to a proposed extract.
C. Publishing the excluded passage as part of the quotation.
D. Quoting the permitted material under the stated condition.
boss.explain: 條件式許可明排特定段，不推真實法律效力。

boss.desc: 【短文】The edited interview places a hesitant answer immediately after a forceful question originally asked much later. The words themselves are unchanged. What can shift?
options: A. The speaker’s actual age when the recorded events occurred.
B. The original recording’s chronological order as an event in the past.
C. The identity of every person mentioned in the answer.
D. The apparent relation between question, hesitation and reply.
boss.explain: 剪接可改語用關係，不改原過去事實。

boss.desc: 請唸出：經家族傳下來的故事
boss.speak: an inherited family narrative

boss.desc: 請唸出：編輯可改問題與答案關係
boss.ans: EDITORIAL CHANGES CAN ALTER THE RELATION BETWEEN QUESTION AND ANSWER
boss.speak: editorial changes can alter the relation between question and answer
boss.vocabId: R7:EDITORIAL CHANGES CAN ALTER THE RELATION BETWEEN QUESTION AND ANSWER

boss.desc: 請拼出：回看並思考過往的行為（R 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: retrospection

boss.desc: 填空題：R E C _ N T E _ T U A _ I S E (把某事放入新脈絡理解或呈現)
boss.speak: recontextualise

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It was not the volume that bothered me so much as the fact that I could not predict when it would start again.
options: A. 因能預測再響時間，所以不覺得困擾。
B. 聲音從未停止，因此不存在等待。
C. 較困擾的是不知何時再響，而非音量本身。
D. 最困擾的是聲音太小，難以辨出內容。
boss.explain: not…so much as…將重點移至不確定性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: They described the library as hushed, which is not quite the same as saying that nobody was there.
options: A. 館內無人，所以沒有其他解讀。
B. 館內擁擠吵雜，無法低聲交談。
C. 說話者主張圖書館應停止開放。
D. 低聲安靜不代表館內沒有人。
boss.explain: hushed描述聲音氛圍，非人數斷言。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Calling it background noise makes it sound incidental, whereas for the people living above the venue it structures the whole evening.
options: A. 對住樓上的人，所謂背景噪音其實支配整晚。
B. 對住樓上的人，噪音只是無關痛癢的小事。
C. 場地把居民的生活聲當成表演配樂。
D. 居民已同意用音樂安排每晚活動。
boss.explain: whereas對照旁觀命名與受影響者經驗；structures不是自願安排。

boss.desc: 【語用】The speaker says, If we could hear the soloist, that would be lovely, while looking towards a noisy group. What is the likely function?
options: A. An offer to introduce the group to the soloist.
B. An expression of doubt that a soloist has been booked.
C. A politely pointed request for the group to be quieter.
D. A request for the soloist to describe the instrument.
boss.explain: 情境目光與條件句共同構成委婉但帶提醒意味的請求。

boss.desc: 【語意】The report says residents tolerated the noise, not that they welcomed it. Which inference is justified?
options: A. They actively requested an increase in volume.
B. They failed to notice that any noise existed.
C. They agreed that the noise should never be discussed.
D. They put up with it, but approval is not established.
boss.explain: tolerate容忍，不等於喜歡；後半明確限制推論。

boss.desc: 【語意】The narrator reports a silence that felt accusatory, while admitting that the other person may simply have been tired. What remains unresolved?
options: A. Whether the silence expressed blame or was interpreted that way.
B. Whether the narrator noticed any pause in the conversation.
C. Whether the other person had spoken earlier that day.
D. Whether the narrator heard a specific accusation clearly.
boss.explain: felt描述主觀感受，may simply have been tired提供未排除的替代解釋。

boss.desc: 請唸出：刻意克制的表達方式
boss.speak: a deliberately restrained delivery

boss.desc: 請唸出：看似附帶的聲音可能支配他人的晚上
boss.ans: AN APPARENTLY INCIDENTAL SOUND MAY DOMINATE SOMEONE ELSE'S EVENING
boss.speak: an apparently incidental sound may dominate someone else's evening
boss.vocabId: R7:AN APPARENTLY INCIDENTAL SOUND MAY DOMINATE SOMEONE ELSE'S EVENING

boss.desc: 請拼出：不引人注意也不造成干擾的（U 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: unobtrusive

boss.desc: 填空題：R E V _ R B _ R A _ I O N (聲音反射後持續的回響)
boss.speak: reverberation
